title: Mobile Application Developer
description:
Sr Principal Engineer - Mobile Applications

Job Description

**Senior Principal Engineer - Mobile Applications**

Job Details

* **Location:**
  Hyderabad, India (
  **100% Work from Office**
  )
* **Experience Required:**
  12–15 Years
* **Job Type:**
  Full-Time / Permanent

Role description

**We are looking for a visionary Principal Mobile Engineer/Lead**
with 12+ years of software engineering experience to lead the architecture, engineering strategy, and execution of our next-generation, high-scale enterprise customer-facing mobile applications.

This role demands a unique combination of deep core engineering and modern technical innovation. The candidate will be responsible for two primary transformation goals:

* Heading the complex, zero-downtime migration of our enterprise mobility ecosystem from .NET MAUI / Xamarin architectures over to a Flutter (Dart) production framework.
* Architecting and embedding native, production-grade AI/ML features (GenAI, On-Device LLMs, Agentic workflows) directly into the customer journey.

Must-Have Core Skills

* **Total Experience:**
  12+ years in Software Development, with at least 6+ years strictly operating as a Mobile Architect / Tech Lead.
* **Customer-Facing App Portfolio:**
  A proven track record of shipping multi-million user B2C mobile apps.
* **Framework Mastery (.NET MAUI & Xamarin):**
  Expert-level proficiency in C#, .NET Core, XAML, MVVM patterns, and extensive lifecycle migration experience to .NET MAUI.
* **Framework Mastery (Flutter):**
  Deep expertise in Dart, Flutter engine architecture, widget rendering lifecycles, and advanced reactive state management paradigms.
* **Cloud Infrastructure:**
  High proficiency integrating apps with AWS, including API Management Gateways, CDNs, Push Notification hubs (FCM, APNs), and modern identity management systems (Azure AD/Entra ID, Okta, Auth0).
* Experience setting up analytics, user behavior tracking, and crash-reporting suites (Firebase, App Center, New Relic, Dynatrace).
* Exposure to cross-platform multi-device targets like Flutter/MAUI for Desktop (Windows/macOS) or Web targets.

Required Skills

Mobile Architect • .NET MAUI • Flutter • Dart • C# • Xamarin Migration • Tech Modernization • Enterprise Applications • Mobile App Migration • BLoC / Riverpod • MVVM • iOS & Android • Mobile Security • Azure DevOps

**📍 Location:**
Hyderabad |
**⏳ Experience:**
12+

* Solid understanding of mobile app performance optimization, memory management, and mobile-specific security best practices.
* Experience in the Streaming Industry is a plus.
* Proven experience with Agile development methodologies and tools (e.g., Scrum, Jira).
* Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.
* Excellent communication and teamwork skills to work effectively with cross-functional teams.
* Familiarity with continuous integration and deployment (CI/CD) pipelines is advantageous.
* Experience with AI-based development tools and techniques to improve efficiency and code quality.

title: Mobile application developer - Healthcare Technology / Health Monitoring Applications
description:
**Company Description**
Arkin Software Technologies is a CMMI Level 3 appraised company and Oracle Gold Partner, specializing in complex enterprise IT solutions including legacy and database migration, automated testing, product engineering, and custom application services. The organization leverages in-house automation tools and solution frameworks to deliver scalable, high-quality outcomes. With over 400 person-years of domain experience, Arkin Software has developed SOA-compliant, web-based solutions that support central securities depositories across multiple Latin American markets. The company collaborates with technology start-ups on product engineering and partners with large enterprises to provide a broad range of IT solutions, offering team members exposure to diverse technologies and business domains.
  
**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site role for a Mobile Application Developer focused on Healthcare Technology and Health Monitoring Applications, based in Hyderabad. The person in this role will design, develop, and maintain mobile applications, ensuring secure, reliable, and user-friendly experiences for healthcare and health monitoring use cases. Responsibilities include collaborating with product managers, UX designers, and backend engineers to define application requirements, implement features, and integrate with APIs and data services. The role involves writing clean, maintainable code using object-oriented programming principles, performing unit and integration tests, and optimizing performance across devices and platforms. The Mobile Application Developer will also participate in code reviews, contribute to technical documentation, and support ongoing enhancements and issue resolution for existing applications.
  
**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong skills in Mobile Application Development and Application Development, with experience delivering production-ready mobile solutions.
* Candidates should possess experience working with Mobile Applications in healthcare or health monitoring domains, including secure data handling and integration with backend services.
* Candidates should possess solid Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) skills and familiarity with modern design patterns and best practices.
* Candidates should possess hands-on experience in iOS Development (Swift/Objective-C), and exposure to cross-platform or Android development is an advantage.
* Relevant skills such as RESTful API integration, database usage on mobile platforms, and performance optimization for mobile apps are beneficial.
* A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience, is preferred.
* Ability to work collaboratively in an on-site team environment in Hyderabad, communicate clearly with cross-functional stakeholders, and adapt to evolving project needs is expected.
* Experience in healthcare technology, health monitoring systems, or regulated environments, along with awareness of data privacy and security standards, will be an added advantage.

title: Software Development Engineer
description:
**Description**
Amazon's mission is to be 'Earth's most customer-centric company', and our award-winning Customer Service (CS) team is an essential part of that mission. Amazon CS is one of the largest customer service organizations in the world. Our tens of thousands of Customer Service Associates around the globe provide world-class support to customers 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, and in over 20 languages (and growing).
  
  
Amazon Customer Service's mission is to make customer service interactions so good they become the primary reason customers choose Amazon.
  
  
The Customer Facing Solutions (CFS) tech organization powers CS by developing elegant customer-facing products on digital channels. These products offer effortless self-service and automation solutions to our customers and deliver delightful, adaptive self-service experiences that empower them to resolve common issues conveniently and efficiently. Our product portfolio includes CS Homepage, CS Chatbot, Search, SEO and Help, and bringing CS to other digital channels of Amazon like Rufus and WhatsApp. Across these products and the backend services that power them, CFS Tech is driving the development of modernized, scalable technologies, including generative AI solutions, to raise the bar for customer self-service at Amazon.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Design, build, and own high-quality software features across the full development lifecycle — from requirements and design through implementation, testing, deployment, and operations
  
  
Deliver improvements to major portions of the team's codebase, including refactoring and deprecation work
  
  
Write clear, maintainable code and provide meaningful feedback through code review for engineers at all levels
  
  
Identify and resolve root causes of operational issues; drive improvements to team operational health
  
  
Collaborate with customers, stakeholders, and peers to understand business requirements and translate them into reliable, scalable software solutions
  
  
Produce clear technical documentation so software can be understood, maintained, and extended by the broader team
  
  
Mentor and actively train teammates, including new hires, on team systems and engineering best practices
  
  
Make sound priority tradeoffs between new feature development and operational work
  
  
Stay current with industry innovations — new technologies, design patterns, and engineering practices — and apply them where relevant
  
  
Contribute to a culture of inclusive, constructive dialogue and continuous improvement within the team
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: Senior IT Technologist - SAP ABAP, S/4HANA and BTP
description:
Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.
  
  
**A Day in the Life**
As a Senior SAP ABAP, S/4 HANA & BTP professional, you will play a critical role in designing, developing, and delivering innovative SAP solutions that support our digital transformation journey. You will work across SAP ECC, S/4HANA, Fiori, and SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) technologies, collaborating with cross-functional teams to build scalable, secure, and high-quality solutions that drive business value.
  
  
**Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned.**

* Manage the end-to-end lifecycle of SAP development objects across SAP ECC, S/4HANA, Fiori, and BTP environments.
* Partner with functional leads, architects, and business stakeholders to translate business requirements into scalable technical solutions.
* Design, develop, test, document, and deploy SAP developments following established coding standards and best practices.
* Support SAP transformation initiatives, including ECC to S/4HANA migrations and clean core strategies.
* Develop solutions using SAP ABAP, CDS Views, AMDPs, RAP, CAP, UI5, Fiori, and BTP services.
* Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues across ECC, S/4HANA, Fiori, and BTP applications.
* Ensure compliance with organizational standards, security requirements, and governance policies.
* Collaborate with integration teams and external vendors to deliver high-quality integrated solutions.
* Stay current with emerging SAP technologies, tools, and development methodologies.

**Required Knowledge and Experience:**

* 7+ years of IT experience with a bachelor’s degree in Engineering, MCA, or MSc or MBA.
* Strong experience delivering end-to-end SAP development solutions in Greenfield and Brownfield S/4HANA implementation projects.
* Experience translating business requirements into technical designs, development, testing, and deployment activities.
* Strong working knowledge of SAP business processes across SD, MM, FI, and CO modules.
* Experience with: SAP S/4HANA implementations and conversions SAP HANA architecture CDS Views and Annotations ABAP Managed Database Procedures (AMDP) Custom code remediation Eclipse ADT
* Expertise in: SAP UI5 Framework SAP Fiori and Fiori Elements Fiori dashboards and applications.
* Development experience with: SAP BTP services Cloud Application Programming Model (CAP) RESTful Application Programming Model (RAP) SAP Cloud Foundry SAP Business Application Studio (BAS) GitHub.
* Experience with OData services, SAP Gateway, and debugging tools.
* Knowledge of SAP and non-SAP integration technologies.
* Experience adhering to SAP ABAP NW 7.5 coding standards and ATC compliance requirements.
* Experience with: BRF+ AIF Framework Web Services ALE/IDocs Proxies Enhancements (BADIs, Exits, BTEs) Smart Forms and Adobe Forms Workflow
* Strong Object-Oriented ABAP (OOABAP) development skills.
* Experience supporting upgrades, SPAU/SPDD activities, regression testing, and performance optimization.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience within the Medical Device, Healthcare, or Pharmaceutical industry.
* Knowledge of SAP Production Planning (PP) and Plant Maintenance (PM) modules.
* Familiarity with Bitbucket.
* Understanding of SAP Security and Authorization concepts.
* Knowledge of SAP integration methodologies and enterprise integration patterns.
* SAP certifications in ABAP or related SAP technologies.

**Physical Job Requirements**
The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this position, but they are not an exhaustive list of all the required responsibilities and skills of this position.
  
  
‌
  
  
‌
  
  
**Recruitment Fraud Alert**
We are aware of phishing scams targeting job seekers. Please keep the following in mind:
  
  
Apply only through official Medtronic channels. All legitimate Medtronic recruiting communications come from approved Medtronic platforms and official @medtronic.com email addresses.
  
  
Medtronic will never ask for payment or sensitive personal information (such as bank account or Social Security details) during early stages of the hiring process. Any such requests are not legitimate.
  
  
If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Medtronic, do not respond, click links, or open attachments.
  
  
If you have any questions, concerns regarding the authenticity of a communication alleged to have been made by or on behalf of Medtronic, please contact us immediately at AskHR@medtronic.com.
  
  
**Benefits & Compensation**
**Medtronic offers a competitive Salary and flexible Benefits Package**
A commitment to our employees lives at the core of our values. We recognize their contributions. They share in the success they help to create. We offer a wide range of benefits, resources, and competitive compensation plans designed to support you at every career and life stage.
  
  
‌
  
  
This position is eligible for a short-term incentive called the Medtronic Incentive Plan (MIP).

title: SAP - ABAP - Associate
description:
The Opportunity
  
  
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. You’ll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
  
  
As a SAP ABAP Senior Associate you will support client service work within our Advisory practice, using SAP technology skills to help design, configure, develop, and support business application solutions that improve operational efficiency and fit the needs of the business. As a Senior Associate you will analyze complex problems, manage assigned workstreams, build meaningful client connections, and develop the confidence to guide junior team members while navigating changing priorities and varied perspectives. In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will contribute to SAP Core ERP work across finance, customer, and supply chain processes, translate business needs into technical solutions, and bring careful attention to quality, communication, and follow-through across delivery activities.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Analyzing client requirements and translating them into SAP ABAP development tasks across finance, customer, and supply chain processes
* Developing, enhancing, and maintaining ABAP programs, reports, interfaces, forms, and enhancements within SAP Core ERP environments
* Configuring and supporting SAP technical components, including SAP Fiori, SAP HANA, and NetWeaver-based solutions
* Troubleshooting application issues, interpreting technical feedback, and resolving defects across development and deployment cycles
* Supporting SAP implementation and modernization efforts by contributing to design discussions, testing activities, and deployment readiness
* Reviewing work assigned to junior team members and providing guidance on coding approaches, technical standards, and issue resolution
* Collaborating with client stakeholders to understand business context, anticipate needs, and adapt deliverables as priorities shift
* Using analytical thinking and process improvement skills to streamline SAP solutions and support operational efficiency
* Applying data-driven insights to inform technical recommendations and improve system performance across SAP landscapes

What You Must Have
  
  

* At least a Bachelor's degree
* At least 3 years of experience
* Oral and written proficiency in English required

What Sets You Apart
  
  

* At least one of the following: One or more SAP certifications aligned to SAP Technology and platform solutions, including SAP S/4HANA System Administration, SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP), SAP Integration Suite, SAP Security, or related technical architecture credentials
* Demonstrating hands-on ABAP development across SAP Core ERP environments
* Applying SAP Fiori, SAP HANA, and SAP NetWeaver technical skills
* Interpreting business requirements into scalable SAP technical solutions
* Navigating client conversations with clear, concise technical communication
* Mentoring junior team members while managing assigned workstreams

title: SDE II, AB Mobile
description:

Are you interested to improve the mobile shopping experience for B2B customers, if the answer is Yes, come join us.
  
  
Amazon Business is a rapidly expanding $35 billion-dollar global business where we're building solutions that disrupt the status quo. We are seeking a Salesforce Engineer II to join our CRM Technology team. In this role, you will be responsible for developing, enhancing, integrating, and supporting Salesforce solutions across Financial Services Cloud (FSC), Agentforce, OmniStudio, and the Salesforce Platform.
  
  
The ideal candidate will have good Salesforce development skills, experience building integrations, and a passion for delivering scalable, secure, and high-quality solutions while working closely with business and technology teams.

**What are we looking for?**
We’re looking for strong collaborators who deliver exceptional client experiences and thrive in fast-paced, team-oriented environments. Our ideal candidates pursue greatness, act with integrity, and are driven to help our clients succeed. We value those who embrace creativity, continuous improvement, and contribute to a culture where we win together and create and share joy in our work.
  
  
**Requirements**

* 8+ years of hands-on Salesforce development experience.
* 5+ years of experience implementing Financial Services Cloud (FSC) solutions.
* 2+ years of hands-on experience with Salesforce Data Cloud, including customer data unification, identity resolution, segmentation, activation, and Customer 360 implementations.
* 2+ years of hands-on experience with Agentforce, Salesforce AI, AI Agents, Prompt Builder, Copilot, or Generative AI solutions on the Salesforce platform.
* 2+ years of experience with Copado deployment automation, CI/CD pipelines, Salesforce DX, source control, and Salesforce release management.
* Expertise in Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Salesforce Flow, SOQL, SOSL, and Salesforce Platform architecture.
* Experience with REST APIs, Platform Events, ,OAuth, JWT Authentication, and enterprise integration patterns.
* Understanding of Salesforce security architecture, including profiles, permission sets, sharing models, role hierarchies, and governance.
* Experience working within Agile/Scrum development environments.
* Good analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

**Preferred Certifications**

* Salesforce Certified Platform Developer I
* Salesforce Certified Platform Developer II
* Salesforce Financial Services Cloud Consultant
* Salesforce Data Cloud Consultant
* Salesforce Agentforce Specialist
* Salesforce Application Architect
* Copado Fundamentals Certification

* Able to make quick decisions and resolve complex technical problems
* Ability to manage through shift changes and effectively transition open and unresolved issues.
* Ability to adapt, learn new technologies, develop new processes, and improve procedures.
* Excellent documentation skills.
* Ability to write, read, interpret, and edit complex documents and correspondence with team members and stakeholders.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Ability to work peak, off-peak, weekend, and holiday shifts.

* Ability to perform problem-solving, use logic and creative thought processes to resolve complex technical problems.

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organizations in the world, with operations in 58 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realize their ambitions.
  
  
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of
**Global Sanctions Technology Executive, GPS**
**The Opportunity**
Own the strategy, integrated delivery, modernisation and reliable operation of HSBC’s global sanctions screening capabilities within the GPS value stream in Global Payments Solutions, with explicit end-to-end technology accountability for
**Name Screening**
and
**Transaction Screening**
. The role leads approximately
**200 colleagues**
and strategic partners supporting around
**68 million screened transactions each month across 48 markets**
, together with the global party and record populations subject to continuous Name Screening, and provides a single point of technology leadership for roadmap execution, production readiness, resilience uplift, service transition and safe change.
  
  
Translate the Screening Future State Architecture into controlled, measurable platform outcomes, bringing
**Name Screening**
and
**Transaction Screening**
together within a coherent
**Screening-as-a-Service**
strategy. Move fragmented, duplicative and vendor-centric utilities toward standard interfaces, common reusable services, consolidated screening data, end-to-end observability, consistent adjudication and governed automation, while retaining the distinct risk, regulatory, criticality, latency, resilience, geography and data-residency requirements of each screening type. The strategic direction is to shift from high-volume alert processing to outcome-led risk protection: preventing access or transactions outside risk appetite, improving true-positive detection, reducing false positives and manual intervention, and minimising unnecessary customer friction.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Strategy, roadmap and investment: Own the multi-year global sanctions technology strategy and integrated roadmap for Name Screening and Transaction Screening, aligned to Group strategy, financial-crime risk appetite, regulatory expectations and the CBCC Future State Architecture. Set priorities, funding and sequencing to create a coherent Screening-as-a-Service utility, standardise the global operating model and shared building blocks, and make explicit build, buy, partner and retire decisions based on risk effectiveness, resilience, customer outcomes, strategic control and total cost.
* Name Screening and Transaction Screening transformation: Lead progressive modernisation across both screening domains. For Name Screening, advance globally consistent, model-driven continuous screening triggered by onboarding, party change, list change and risk events, with local variation only where regulation or data and hosting residency require it. For Transaction Screening, deliver high-throughput, real-time and 24x7 capabilities with regional segregation, scalable capacity, graceful degradation and no uncontrolled bypass, while strengthening tuning, layered auto-discounting and rapid response to geopolitical or regulatory change.
* Architecture, engineering and release excellence: Establish secure, scalable patterns across cloud and hybrid deployment, Kubernetes, Java/Spring, APIs, event streaming, distributed databases, caching, CI/CD and infrastructure automation. Embed automated testing, configuration management, observability, performance engineering and evidence-based release readiness, while meeting data and hosting residency requirements and maximising global standards and reuse.
* Risk effectiveness and control governance: Maintain zero tolerance for sanctions breaches and strengthen the effectiveness of Name Screening and Transaction Screening in line with policy, regulatory expectations and risk appetite. Improve true-positive detection while evidencing reductions in false positives; govern lists, policies, models, algorithms, filters, thresholds, routing, tuning and discounting through validation, impact analysis, segregation of duties, maker-checker controls, reconciliation, auditability and global standards with local divergence by approved exception.
* Service readiness, resilience and production outcomes: Own availability, capacity, performance, recoverability and continuity for mission-critical sanctions services, including evolution toward 24x7 transaction and continuous name screening. Ensure every material change is supportable and recoverable, with production-like testing, viable back-out, clear handover, post-implementation verification and sustainable remediation of incident, service-review and control-assessment actions.
* Data, observability, automation and AI: Create a trusted, consolidated screening data asset spanning Name Screening and Transaction Screening, with strong quality, lineage, completeness, reconciliation and end-to-end tracking from screening event to risk outcome. Use real-time analytics and transparent management information to support assurance and regulatory evidence. Govern AI-assisted matching, entity resolution, triage, prioritisation, recommendations and layered auto-discounting with human accountability, explainability, validation, drift monitoring, feedback loops and safe fallback arrangements, progressively moving toward near-zero-touch operations where the control evidence supports it.
* Customer and operational outcomes: Embed Name Screening and Transaction Screening controls seamlessly into customer onboarding, servicing and payment journeys. Apply risk-based segmentation, improve data capture at source and provide predictable turnaround and proactive status information. Reduce duplicate screens, repeat alerts, manual adjudication and unnecessary requests for information, while ensuring Financial Crime and Operations have the data needed to make timely decisions to reject, block, freeze, escalate or exit in accordance with policy.
* Leadership, governance and stakeholder alignment: Lead and develop a globally distributed, inclusive engineering organisation; own workforce shape, investment priorities, standards, talent and succession plans. Establish transparent, decision-oriented governance across Financial Crime, Operations, Global Businesses, regions, Group Data, Foundations Technology, Architecture, Cybersecurity, Risk, Audit, Finance and Procurement; manage suppliers against measurable delivery, quality, security and service-readiness outcomes.

**Measures of success**

* Predictable delivery of the Screening-as-a-Service roadmap for Name Screening and Transaction Screening against approved milestones, investment and benefit commitments, with greater reuse of common capabilities and less duplication across screening types, regions and products.
* Measurably improved risk effectiveness across Name Screening and Transaction Screening: stronger true-positive detection and designation-to-action outcomes, controlled reductions in false positives, duplicate alerts, manual adjudication and repeated customer outreach, and faster risk-led decisioning.
* Resilient, secure and scalable screening services, including continuous Name Screening and real-time 24x7 Transaction Screening, with improved availability, throughput, recovery performance and capacity for peak volumes, list events and regulatory change, and reduced change failure, high-severity incidents and customer disruption.
* Reliable data, observability and regulatory evidence, with demonstrable governance of lists, models, policies, filters, algorithms, AI and configuration changes.
* A sustainable, inclusive and high-performing global technology organisation and effective strategic supplier ecosystem.

**Role**
**What you will need to succeed in the role**

* Significant senior technology, engineering and platform-delivery leadership experience in global payments, sanctions screening, financial crime technology or a comparable regulated, mission-critical domain.
* Proven delivery of complex, multi-year transformation across regions, business lines, platforms and suppliers, including legacy modernisation and product/platform operating models.
* Strong knowledge of transaction and name screening, list management, matching/filtering, adjudication, case management, discounting, customer outreach and associated regulatory controls.
* Deep understanding of cross-border payments, ISO 20022, payment messaging and payment-processing controls, together with the operation of high-volume, high-availability and preferably 24x7 services.

We are looking for a
**Senior AI-Native Mobile Engineer**
with deep expertise in
**native iOS engineering**
and strong fluency in
**Generative AI, Agentic AI, and AI-assisted software engineering practices**
.
  
  
This is
**not a traditional mobile development role**
.
  
  
This role combines the expectations of a
**senior hands-on iOS technical leader**
with the mindset of an
**AI-native engineer**
who helps define how modern mobile applications are designed, built, tested, and delivered using A
  
  
You will lead the design and development of
**high-quality, secure, scalable mobile experiences**
, while also driving adoption of
**AI-powered engineering workflows**
, reusable patterns, and platform capabilities that improve developer productivity and technical outcomes across the mobile organization.
  
  
**You Will Work At The Intersection Of**
**Native iOS Engineering + Generative AI + Agentic AI + Developer Productivity + Mobile Platform Leadership**
**Role Summary / Purpose**
The
**Senior AI-Native Mobile Engineer**
is a senior individual contributor responsible for leading the design, development, and evolution of high-quality iOS applications and shared mobile capabilities. This role provides hands-on technical leadership across application architecture, feature delivery, AI-powered mobile experiences, performance, reliability, security, accessibility, observability, and developer experience.
  
  
The role partners closely with Engineering Managers, Tech Leads, Android engineers, QE leads, backend engineers, architects, and platform teams to deliver scalable, secure, and consistent customer experiences. In addition to strong native mobile engineering depth, this role is expected to actively leverage and champion
**AI-assisted and AI-native engineering practices**
across the software development lifecycle.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Native Mobile Engineering**

* Lead the technical design, development, and delivery of complex native iOS features and platform capabilities.
* Design and build high-quality mobile applications using Swift, SwiftUI, UIKit, Xcode, and Apple’s iOS SDKs.
* Define and apply scalable architecture patterns that ensure maintainability, testability, performance, and alignment with enterprise standards.
* Build secure, performant, reliable mobile applications with strong attention to accessibility and user experience.
* Integrate backend services using REST, GraphQL, WebSocket, and related service patterns.
* Collaborate with backend and platform engineering teams on API contracts, authentication, resiliency, error handling, and service integration requirements.
* Diagnose and resolve complex production issues involving crashes, performance bottlenecks, networking, concurrency, memory management, and application stability.
* Drive best practices for code quality, automated testing, observability, release readiness, and operational excellence.
* Contribute to reusable iOS components, frameworks, SDKs, shared libraries, and mobile platform foundations.
* Partner with Android engineers to promote consistent mobile patterns, shared standards, and cohesive cross-platform experiences.

**Generative AI & Agentic AI**

* Integrate LLM capabilities into mobile applications to enable AI-powered conversational, search, recommendation, and workflow-driven experiences.
* Build production-quality mobile experiences powered by Generative AI and AI agents.
* Integrate AI models and services such as OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Gemini, Claude, or enterprise AI platforms.
* Implement streaming responses, tool/function calling, structured outputs, and multimodal experiences within mobile applications.
* Build and integrate AI agents and agentic workflows that improve customer experience or engineering execution.
* Work with technologies such as MCP, RAG, LangGraph, LangChain, or equivalent orchestration frameworks where appropriate.
* Design secure AI architectures covering data handling, context management, authentication, authorization, privacy, and governance.
* Help define practical standards for safe, scalable adoption of AI in mobile applications within a regulated environment.

**AI-Native Software Engineering**

* Actively leverage AI tools such as GitHub Copilot and other LLM-based engineering tools for code generation, refactoring, testing, documentation, troubleshooting, and technical discovery.
* Build AI-powered workflows across the software development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, architecture, implementation, testing, and code review.
* Explore and develop engineering agents that can interpret Jira stories, analyze codebases, generate implementation plans, and support development workflows.
* Automate repetitive engineering activities using AI agents, developer tools, and intelligent workflows.
* Champion practical AI-assisted engineering practices while maintaining strong engineering judgment, quality, security, and compliance standards.
* Continuously evaluate emerging AI models, coding assistants, agents, frameworks, and developer productivity tools.

**Mobile Platform, Engineering Excellence & Leadership**

* Help establish reusable AI capabilities and engineering patterns across mobile teams.
* Develop common patterns, APIs, SDKs, frameworks, and standards for AI-powered mobile experiences.
* Improve mobile build and release reliability through contributions to CI/CD pipelines, build automation, code-quality gates, security scanning, and deployment workflows.
* Drive mobile observability through crash analytics, performance monitoring, logging, release-health metrics, and rollout analysis.
* Participate in architecture reviews, technical spikes, proof-of-concepts, and design discussions for foundational mobile capabilities.
* Mentor and coach engineers on Swift, SwiftUI, UIKit, architecture, testing, debugging, and technical decision-making.
* Produce clear technical documentation, including design proposals, implementation guidance, architecture decision records, and operational runbooks.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies, PI planning, ART syncs, and cross-team coordination, identifying and escalating technical risks early.
* Contribute to communities of practice, engineering standards, internal knowledge sharing, and developer experience improvements.

**Required Skills/Knowledge**

* Bachelor’s Degree and 5+ years of relevant experience in Information Technology, or in lieu of a degree, 7+ years of relevant experience in Information Technology.
* Strong hands-on experience in native iOS development, with deep production expertise in Swift, SwiftUI, UIKit, Xcode, and Apple’s iOS SDKs. Working knowledge of Android development concepts, Kotlin, and Jetpack Compose is good to have.
* Demonstrated experience designing, building, and supporting production-scale iOS applications.
* Strong understanding of iOS architecture patterns, including MVVM, Clean Architecture, modularization, dependency injection, and coordinator-based navigation, where applicable. Familiarity with Android architecture principles is a plus.
* Strong understanding of performance, security, testing, accessibility, observability, and release engineering for mobile applications.
* Experience integrating mobile applications with RESTful APIs, microservices, authentication services, API gateway patterns, and modern backend services.
* Strong knowledge of Swift concurrency, async/await, actors, GCD, reactive programming, and asynchronous networking.
* Experience building reusable iOS components, frameworks, SDKs, or shared libraries.
* Hands-on experience integrating Generative AI / LLM capabilities into software applications.
* Experience with LLM APIs, prompt engineering, tool/function calling, structured outputs, or AI agents.
* Demonstrated AI fluency, including productive use of GitHub Copilot or equivalent AI-assisted development tools.
* Experience with CI/CD, build automation, code signing, provisioning, test automation, and release workflows.
* Strong testing experience including unit, integration, UI, and automation testing using tools such as XCTest and XCUITest.
* Familiarity with secure coding practices, static analysis, dependency scanning, and mobile security standards.
* Working knowledge of Android architecture and development concepts to enable effective cross-platform collaboration.
* Strong analytical, system design, debugging, problem-solving, and technical communication skills.
* Ability to influence technical decisions and collaborate effectively across teams without direct authority.

* Experience working in Agile delivery environments at scale, including SAFe or similar frameworks.
* Within the first year, you will help us:

+ Deliver production-quality AI-powered mobile experiences on iOS.
+ Establish reusable patterns for AI-native mobile development.
+ Lead the implementation of scalable, secure, and maintainable iOS architecture and platform capabilities.
+ Improve engineering quality and speed through AI-assisted and agentic development workflows.
+ Automate meaningful portions of the mobile software development lifecycle.
+ Strengthen standards for mobile architecture, testing, security, observability, and release engineering.
+ Improve developer productivity through reusable tooling, frameworks, and AI-enabled engineering practices.
+ Help move mobile engineering from AI-assisted development to AI-native engineering.

**Desired Skills/Knowledge**

* Experience with SwiftUI migration strategies from UIKit-based applications.
* Experience with Jetpack Compose and broader Android mobile patterns.
* Experience with OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, Gemini, Claude, or equivalent enterprise AI platforms.
* Experience with MCP, RAG, LangGraph, LangChain, or similar agent orchestration technologies.

* Experience with service virtualization, API mocking, contract testing, and test-environment management.
* Experience with observability platforms such as New Relic, Splunk, Datadog, Firebase Crashlytics, CloudWatch, or similar.
* Experience implementing accessibility aligned with WCAG and Apple accessibility standards.
* Experience in financial services or other regulated, security-sensitive environments.

Swift, SwiftUI, UIKit, Xcode, iOS SDK, Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Android SDK

LLMs, Generative AI, AI Agents, RAG, Tool Calling, MCP, Agentic Workflows

title: Associate IS Engineer
description:
**About Amgen**
Amgen harnesses the best of biology and technology to fight the world’s toughest diseases and make people’s lives easier, fuller, and longer. We discover, develop, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help millions of patients. Amgen helped establish the biotechnology industry more than 40 years ago and remains at the cutting edge of innovation, using technology and human genetic data to push beyond what is known today.
  
  
**Role Description**
We are seeking an Associate IS Engineer to support the delivery, operation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of enterprise applications and digital solutions.
  
  
This is a blended application engineering role combining IT application support, application lifecycle management, technical troubleshooting, integration support, and software development. The successful candidate will work across both run/support activities and change/development initiatives, helping ensure applications remain reliable, secure, compliant, and fit for business needs.
  
  
Working under the guidance of senior engineers, the Associate IS Engineer will investigate and resolve application and integration issues, support application releases and upgrades, participate in incident and problem management, maintain application documentation and configurations, and work with business, infrastructure, platform, security, and vendor teams.
  
  
The role will also contribute to full-stack development and application enhancements, including front-end development, API integration, back-end development, testing, and deployment where required.
  
  
**Roles And Responsibilities**

* Provide day-to-day technical and operational support for enterprise applications and associated integrations which could be either of these SaaS, COTS and Custom-built application
* Monitor application health, availability, interfaces, scheduled jobs, and other operational components, and proactively identify potential issues.
* Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve application incidents, defects, integration failures, data issues, and performance problems.
* Perform technical root-cause analysis and support implementation of corrective and preventive measures for recurring problems.
* Support incident, problem, request, and change-management processes in accordance with established IT service-management practices.
* Work with business users, application owners, infrastructure teams, security teams, integration teams, and external vendors to resolve technical issues.
* Support application configuration, upgrades, patches, releases, environment changes, and production deployments.
* Support application integrations with enterprise platforms, databases, APIs, identity and access-management solutions, and cloud services.
* Maintain application documentation including architecture and interface details, configuration information, operational procedures, troubleshooting guides, and support knowledge articles.
* Contribute to application lifecycle activities including technical assessments, upgrades, modernization, remediation, and application retirement where applicable.
* Participate in periodic operational, security, compliance, and application health activities as required.

**Software Development & Enhancement**

* Contribute to the design, development, testing, deployment, and maintenance of application enhancements and software solutions.
* Manage the application SDLC and supporting ITIL Lifecyle completely
* Translate business and technical requirements into maintainable and user-friendly application functionality.
* Develop or enhance front-end applications using technologies such as React, Vite, TypeScript/JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3.
* Build reusable, responsive, accessible user-interface components following enterprise design standards.
* Integrate applications with RESTful APIs, enterprise services, databases, and third-party platforms.
* Contribute to back-end development using Python and FastAPI, or comparable technologies, under the guidance of senior engineers.
* Participate in technical design discussions, peer code reviews, troubleshooting sessions, and technical walkthroughs.
* Follow coding standards, secure-development practices, reusable software-design patterns, and established engineering practices.
* Develop and maintain appropriate unit, integration, regression, and end-to-end automated tests.
* Support CI/CD processes for automated builds, testing, security scanning, and deployment.
* Analyse and remediate application vulnerabilities, software dependency issues, and technical debt in collaboration with senior engineers.

**Testing, Release & Operational Readiness**

* Create and execute functional, integration, regression, smoke, and end-to-end tests for application changes and releases.
* Support user acceptance testing and resolution of defects identified during testing.
* Validate APIs and system integrations using tools such as Postman or equivalent.
* Support release planning, deployment validation, and post-production verification.
* Ensure appropriate technical and support documentation is available before solutions transition into production.
* Work with support teams to ensure operational readiness for new applications, enhancements, integrations, and releases.

**Collaboration & Continuous Improvement**

* Collaborate with product managers, business stakeholders, application owners, developers, QA professionals, DevOps teams, infrastructure teams, cybersecurity teams, and external vendors.
* Participate in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily stand-ups, demonstrations, and retrospectives.
* Identify opportunities to improve application reliability, automate repetitive operational activities, and reduce recurring support issues.
* Stay current with emerging technologies and practices across application development, cloud, DevOps, API integration, observability, cybersecurity, automation, and AI.

**Basic Qualifications And Experience**

* Master's / Bachelor’s degree with 3–5 years of relevant experience in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, Engineering, or a related field.
* Experience may include a combination of application development, application engineering, production/application support, system integration, testing, or IT operations.

**Must-Have Skills**

* Good understanding of information systems, application architecture, software-development lifecycle, and application-support lifecycle.
* Experience supporting business or enterprise applications in development, test, and/or production environments.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, debugging, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to investigate application incidents, software defects, integration failures, and data-related issues.
* Understanding of incident, problem, change, and release-management processes.
* Working knowledge of REST APIs and application integrations.
* Understanding of relational databases, SQL, and basic data-access concepts.

title: Software Development Engineer, Amazon Fulfillment Technology (AFT), Platform Engineering and Services
description:
**Description**
Amazon Fulfillment Technologies (AFT) powers the physical engine at the heart of Amazon — magically turning your click of a button into packages at your door. Within AFT, the Labor Insights team builds and operates the platform that tracks on associate labor performance across Amazon's entire global warehouse network. Labor Insights' suite of 18+ services supports ~1 million associates and 70,000+ daily portal users across 9,800+ facilities and 10 business lines — ingesting over 19 billion labor events annually to produce the real-time productivity reports that warehouse managers rely on to run their operations every day. We leverage AWS technologies, stream processing, and AI/ML to build distributed, highly available systems that operate at massive scale.
  
  
Are you ready for a challenge? As a Software Development Engineer on the Labor Insights team, you will build the next generation of Amazon's labor management platform — designing systems that ingest billions of labor events from warehouse floor tools and time clock systems, aggregate them through multi-stage pipelines, and serve real-time productivity reports to operations managers across the globe. You will own design and development of distributed systems that refresh reports every 10–15 minutes across 3 global regions while maintaining 99.9% availability. You will contribute to a wide range of projects — from event processing pipelines and aggregation engines to reporting APIs, modern React-based portals, and AI-powered configuration tools. Most excitingly, you will help drive refresh of the existing tool, an AI-first greenfield initiative to rebuild the platform from the ground up using modern stream-based architecture, eliminating a decade of technical debt and delivering near real-time metrics. You will be involved in all aspects of the software development cycle including scoping, design, implementation, testing, and delivery. A commitment to teamwork, hustle, and strong communication skills are absolute requirements. Creating reliable, scalable, and high-performance services requires exceptional technical expertise. If you have that expertise, are customer-centric, and motivated about building systems that operate at global scale, then we want to talk to you!
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Design, develop, and test software components across Labor Insights' ingestion, aggregation, reporting, and configuration layers — handling labor events, time clock punches, employee location tracking, and productivity report generation
* Build new services using AI-assisted development practices, leveraging tools like Amazon Q and Bedrock to achieve high-velocity delivery on greenfield systems
* Design large-scale data processing solutions using DynamoDB, PostgreSQL, S3, SQS/SNS, EventBridge, Lambda, and stream processing frameworks (Cosmos/Flink) optimized for high throughput and low-latency access
* Drive service consolidation and modernization — migrating from legacy infrastructure to Native AWS (NAWS) with full CI/CD pipelines
* Participate in definition of coding standards and apply them in code and design reviews
* Provide estimates for development tasks and negotiate timelines with project leaders
* Mentor junior team members and help them acquire critical skills and best practices
* Document and communicate technical concepts to team members and stakeholders
* Participate in deep technical discussions, where you stand up for your ideas and work with team members to find the best solution for the customer
* Identify technical and project risks and take initiative to mitigate them

A day in the life
  
  
Full-cycle ownership. You contribute to all aspects of the software development cycle — from scoping and design through implementation, testing, and delivery of features that provide labor performance visibility to Amazon's global fulfillment operations.
  
  
Billions-scale data processing. You build systems that ingest 19+ billion labor events per year from warehouse floor tools, time clock systems, and employee location heartbeats. You design multi-stage aggregation pipelines that process this data into PPR and PPA reports refreshed every 10–15 minutes, served to 70K+ daily users across 9,800+ facilities.
  
  
AWS-native architecture. You leverage the full AWS stack — DynamoDB for hot data storage, S3 for historical data, PostgreSQL for aggregated reports, SQS/SNS for event-driven processing, EventBridge and Lambda for serverless job orchestration, and Cosmos/Flink for stream processing. You architect for 99.9% availability across 3 global regions (NA, EU, FE).
  
  
AI-first development. You pioneer AI-assisted engineering practices — using Amazon Bedrock, Amazon Q, and AI-powered tools to accelerate greenfield development at 20X traditional velocity. You build intelligent systems like AI-powered configuration assistants, automated intake routing, and GenAI-driven operational tooling.
  
  
Modernization at scale. You modernize a 15+ year-old platform serving every fulfillment center worldwide — consolidating 23+ services into a clean microservices architecture, rebuilding the portal experience in React from legacy JSP/jQuery, and transitioning from batch to stream processing, all while maintaining zero-downtime operations.
  
  
**About The Team**
About Labor Insights: We build Amazon's global labor management platform — the system of record for measuring associate performance across every fulfillment center, sort center, delivery station, and grocery facility worldwide. Labor Insights tracks how ~1 million associates spend their time, producing the productivity reports (PPR, PPA, attendance, Time Off Task) that operations managers use to make staffing decisions, identify bottlenecks, and ensure customer shipments go out on time.
  
  
**What Makes This Role Exciting**

* Build FCLM 2.0 from the ground up — a once-in-a-career opportunity to greenfield a platform that runs Amazon's global workforce visibility, using AI-first development to deliver in months what would take years through traditional approaches
* Pioneer stream processing — transition from batch to real-time with sub-minute latencies using Cosmos/Flink, fundamentally changing how Amazon tracks labor performance
* Build a multi-tenant platform (FCLM FLEX) — design a configurable translation layer that recasts PPR and PPA as flexible views on the same underlying data, eliminating duplicate pipelines and enabling third-party teams to create custom labor views without engineering support
* Reimagine the portal experience — rebuild the portal used by 70K+ daily users from legacy JSP/jQuery into a modern React application with accessibility, localization, and scalable access controls
* Expand to new businesses — onboard Amazon Grocery (Fresh, Whole Foods) and other new business lines in 2026+, scaling the platform to new node types and labor models
* Build AI-powered tools — design intelligent systems using Amazon Bedrock for automated configuration management, request intake, and operational copilots that serve 1.5M workers globally
* Massive impact — every feature you build is used by tens of thousands of warehouse managers the same day; Labor Insights’ operations save an estimated $25M+ annually

**Our Tenets**

* Build for Scale: Design generically to support multiple use cases beyond Labor Insights
* Service Generalization for Multi-Tenancy: Build abstractions that work across all businesses
* No Data Filtering by Default: Accept all incoming data, build flexible views on top

**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Software Development Engineer III - Salesforce
description:
At F5, we strive to bring a better digital world to life. Our teams empower organizations across the globe to create, secure, and run applications that enhance how we experience our evolving digital world. We are passionate about cybersecurity, from protecting consumers from fraud to enabling companies to focus on innovation.
  
  
Everything we do centers around people. That means we obsess over how to make the lives of our customers, and their customers, better. And it means we prioritize a diverse F5 community where each individual can thrive.
  
  
**Why do you want to join our team?**
Life at F5 is never dull. We are constantly identifying industry trends and disruptions, then innovating to get ahead of future customer needs—creating application services that help the world’s leading organizations deliver their critical business apps faster and with the highest levels of flexibility, security, performance, and support.
  
  
But our success isn’t driven solely by what we do. We care deeply about how we do it. At F5, our culture is how we live every single day. This produces extraordinary results—not only for our customers but also for our employees. We are committed to a culture that supports your whole life.
  
  
Come work at a place where innovation and teamwork come together to build and support the most exciting missions in the world! You get the adventure and independence of working at a start-up without any of the financial risks because you are supported by a growing Fortune 1000 technology company.
  
  
**What will you do?**
Our Software Development Engineer provides software development support by analyzing business requirements to design and develop appropriate system solutions. They bring technical expertise in evaluating, designing, developing, deploying, monitoring, and supporting systems and procedures that are cost-effective and improve work efficiency. The Software Development Engineer also collaborates with Enterprise and Solution Architects to ensure applications meet company service level standards and roadmap requirements.
  
  
**Your Primary Responsibilities will include:**

* Design Reliable Full-Stack Solutions:

+ Analyze and translate complex business requirements into scalable, reusable, and future-proof system solutions.
+ Develop full-stack applications (Salesforce front-end and back-end customizations) with occasional work on cross-platform frameworks like React, Next.js, or Python to enable broader solutions.

* Agentic Frameworks Expertise:

+ Develop and implement solutions using agentic frameworks such as AgentForce, or an equivalent, for automating processes and driving efficiency.

* Salesforce Development:

+ Create robust Salesforce features (Apex, Aura, LWC components) with secure and high-performance design.
+ Seamlessly integrate Salesforce with external/internal systems and authentication patterns (e.g., OAuth).

* AI-Driven Enhancements:

+ Apply AI-driven tools like Copilot or Codex to optimize workflows and introduce predictive and automation features into systems.

* Cloud and AWS Development:

+ Build, deploy, and maintain services using AWS ecosystem tools. Adapt integration practices with secure authentication methods such as API Gateway and IAM roles.

* CI/CD, DevOps, and Agile:

+ Manage CI/CD pipelines for seamless application deployment using tools like GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps.
+ Collaborate within an Agile/Scrum environment, engaging dynamically with architects and product stakeholders.

* Monitor and Improve Systems:

+ Partner with reliability engineers to ensure applications meet performance, security, and operational needs.
+ Identify opportunities for innovation using AI tools to enhance automation and productivity.

**Other Responsibilities**

* Uphold F5’s Business Code of Ethics and promptly report any violations.
* Contribute to company culture through teamwork and innovation.
* Provide excellent customer service and support to both internal and external stakeholders.

**What do you need to be successful in this role?**

* Experience & Expertise:

+ 5+ years of full-stack development experience at scale, with strong exposure to Salesforce and agentic frameworks (e.g., AgentForce or other).
+ Advanced Salesforce skills: AgentForce, Data Cloud, Apex, Aura, and Lightning Web Components.
+ Proven ability to build solutions using agentic platforms for process automation and scalability.
+ Solid understanding of AWS services (deployment, authentication, integration patterns).

* Technical Skills:

+ Proficient in web development and cross-platform frameworks (React, TypeScript, Java Spring Boot, Python).
+ Familiarity with relational and NoSQL databases (e.g., PostgreSQL, CosmosDB).
+ Competence in leveraging AI-assisted workflows for development cycles and automation.

* Soft Skills & Values:

+ Strong communication skills, Agile methodology experience, and problem-solving abilities.
+ Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent field.
+ Commitment to teamwork, innovation, and customer-centric results.

**Our values:**
At F5, we live and breathe our core values: Excellence, Integrity, Collaboration, Customer Loyalty, Profitable Growth, Innovation, Employee Success, and Diversity. We help each other achieve our goals, value diverse ideas from different backgrounds, emphasize teamwork, and most importantly, we have fun.

Learn more about working for ValGenesis, the de facto standard for paperless validation in Life Sciences: https://www.valgenesis.com/about
  
  
About the Role:

title: Engineer III Software
description:
Fanatics Commerce is the global leader in licensed sports merchandise, operating a vertically integrated platform that designs, manufactures, and delivers officially licensed apparel, jerseys, headwear, and collectibles for major leagues, teams, and events worldwide. With more than 900 e-commerce sites and a global omnichannel presence across digital, in-venue, and retail, Fanatics Commerce reaches fans in over 180 countries and powers official fan experiences for many of the world's most iconic sports properties.
  
  
At Fanatics, we bring our BOLD Leadership Principles to life every day - building championship teams, obsessing over fans, acting with entrepreneurial speed, and delivering with a determined and relentless mindset.
  
  
As we continue to scale our global platform, the Software Engineer III — Commerce Applications & Integrations will play a critical role in building and operating the applications that power our wholesale commerce experience end-to-end.
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are seeking a Software Engineer III — Commerce Applications & Integrations to build, operate, and continuously improve the applications that power our wholesale commerce experience — including product and catalog workflows, cart and checkout, order processing, account management, and the internal tools our operations teams rely on every day. This is a full-stack role with real end-to-end ownership spanning application development, APIs and integrations, data processing, cloud infrastructure, production support, incident resolution, security remediation, and operational readiness. The Software Engineer III — Commerce Applications & Integrations delivers business and fan impact through BOLD leadership and execution excellence, leveraging data, automation, and AI-enabled insights.
  
  
**How Will You Drive Impact**
Success is measured by the ability to deliver results through BOLD capabilities and measurable outcomes.
  
  
Team & Leadership Impact (Build Championship Teams)
  
  

* Partner closely with Product, Business Operations, Platform, Security, Data, and Support teams to align on technical decisions, communicate tradeoffs clearly, and ship reliable solutions collaboratively.
* Contribute to architecture discussions, modernization initiatives, and technical discovery, bringing well-reasoned perspectives on schema design, system design, and next-generation commerce capabilities.
* Participate in production support rotations and serve as a dependable technical resource for time-sensitive ordering escalations and cross-functional issue resolution.

Fan & Customer Impact (Obsessed with Fans)
  
  

* Build and enhance wholesale commerce portal capabilities across catalog, cart, checkout, order confirmation, account, product, and user-experience workflows that customers and internal teams depend on daily.
* Support order and fulfillment business rules — including inventory availability, account configuration, ship-window and cancellation dates, and downstream order interfaces — to ensure a seamless ordering experience.
* Improve application reliability through monitoring, alerting, deployment health checks, and release validation so that customer-facing systems perform consistently and at scale.
* Participate in resolving customer access issues and account setup problems, reducing friction in the wholesale commerce experience.

Innovation & Problem Solving (Limitless Entrepreneurial Spirit)
  
  

* Design and develop scalable APIs, integrations, and supporting services using Go, Python, Node.js, and React/TypeScript that keep end-to-end business workflows reliable and extensible.
* Develop scalable data-processing solutions for product, catalog, account, and order workloads, including batch and asynchronous processing pipelines built on AWS services such as SQS/SNS, EventBridge, and Lambda.
* Contribute to application modernization efforts, including schema migration, platform refactoring, and the adoption of infrastructure-as-code practices via Terraform and GitHub Actions.
* Explore and apply emerging tools, patterns, and AI-enabled capabilities to continuously improve the quality, efficiency, and scalability of commerce systems.

Ownership & Execution (Determined & Relentless Mindset)
  
  

* Take end-to-end ownership of ambiguous problems through design, implementation, testing, release, and ongoing operational support across the full commerce application stack.
* Troubleshoot production issues using structured logs, metrics, distributed traces, application behavior, and data analysis; drive root-cause analysis and implement durable fixes rather than patches.
* Address application security and software supply-chain findings — including dependency vulnerabilities, authorization gaps, CI/CD hardening, and least-privilege access — with rigor and urgency.
* Reduce recurring production issues over time by improving monitoring, operational documentation, and the underlying reliability of data and integration workflows.

AI & DIGITAL CAPABILITY
  
  
We are building a future-ready organization. This role is expected to:
  
  

* Apply AI and technology to improve efficiency, quality, and outcomes
* Use data and digital tools to inform decisions and enhance performance
* Demonstrate curiosity and adaptability in adopting new technologies and ways of working
* Contribute to a culture of innovation and continuous improvement

**Required Qualifications**
CAPABILITIES & EXPERIENCE YOU BRING
  
  

* 3–6 years of professional software engineering experience with a strong track record delivering production software as an individual contributor, including full-stack ownership across frontend, backend, APIs, integrations, data, and operational concerns.
* Proficiency with React and TypeScript for building customer-facing web applications, and proficiency in at least one backend language among Go, Python, or Node.js with willingness to work across the others.
* Production experience on AWS, including compute (ECS/EKS, Lambda), storage (S3), managed databases (RDS), and messaging services (SQS/SNS, EventBridge).
* Experience designing scalable APIs, data workflows, batch and asynchronous processing pipelines, and system integrations in a production environment.
* Strong production troubleshooting and root-cause analysis skills using logs, metrics, traces, and data, with the ability to implement durable fixes rather than short-term patches.
* Solid understanding of secure coding practices, dependency management, authorization models, secrets handling, and CI/CD security hardening.

description:
**Job Description: Head of Customer Facing Applications**

**Department:**
Information Technology / Digital

Chief Information Officer (CIO)

**Role Summary**

The Head of Customer Facing Applications owns the strategy, delivery, and performance of every application customers touch: mobile apps, web portals, booking and ordering platforms, payment flows, and self-service channels. The role combines product thinking with engineering and vendor leadership to deliver a fast, secure, and consistent digital experience that grows adoption, revenue, and customer satisfaction.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Digital Product Strategy and Roadmap**

* Define the multi-year roadmap for customer-facing applications, aligned with business goals and customer journeys.
* Prioritize the backlog using customer data, business impact, and technical feasibility.
* Partner with business, marketing, operations, and customer service heads to turn requirements into product outcomes.
* Run discovery, A/B testing, and feedback loops to validate features before and after release.

**2. Application Delivery and Engineering**

* Lead design, build, release, and enhancement of mobile (iOS/Android), web, and portal applications.
* Own architecture standards: API-first, microservices, headless/composable approaches, and reusable components.
* Run agile delivery with clear sprint cadences, release management, and quality gates.
* Oversee QA, test automation, and CI/CD pipelines for fast, safe releases.

**3. Customer Experience (CX) and Design**

* Own UX/UI standards and design systems for a consistent experience across channels.
* Track journey metrics such as conversion, drop-off, task completion time, app ratings, and NPS/CSAT.
* Drive accessibility (WCAG), localization, and multi-language support.
* Use analytics and behavior tools to find friction and prioritize fixes.

**4. Integration and Platform Ownership**

* Ensure seamless integration with core systems: CRM, ERP, core operational platforms, payment gateways, and communication services (SMS, WhatsApp, email, push).
* Manage API gateways, authentication/SSO, and third-party integrations.
* Support omnichannel consistency across app, web, call centre, and in-person touchpoints.

**5. Performance, Reliability, and Support**

* Define and meet SLAs for availability, latency, and scalability, including peak-load readiness.
* Work with infrastructure and DevOps teams on monitoring, observability, and incident response.
* Own L2/L3 application support, root cause analysis, and problem management.
* Maintain disaster recovery and business continuity for customer-facing systems.

**6. Security, Privacy, and Compliance**

* Embed security by design: secure coding, VAPT, OWASP controls, and API security.
* Ensure compliance with DPDP Act, PCI DSS for payments, ISO 27001, and sector regulations as applicable.
* Manage consent, data privacy, and data retention in customer applications.
* Close audit and vulnerability findings within defined timelines.

**7. Data, Analytics, and Innovation**

* Build a data-driven culture with dashboards for adoption, engagement, funnel, and revenue metrics.
* Enable personalization, recommendations, chatbots, and AI-driven features where they add value.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend pilots with clear business cases.

**8. Vendor, Budget, and Team Leadership**

* Manage development partners, SaaS vendors, and agencies: contracts, SLAs, and commercial negotiation.
* Own the application budget, forecasting, and cost-to-serve optimization.
* Lead and develop product managers, engineers, designers, and QA leads; build a strong in-house capability.
* Foster a culture of ownership, experimentation, and continuous improvement.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or IT (Master's or MBA preferred).
* 12-15+ years of experience in software or digital product delivery, with at least 5 years leading teams and customer-facing platforms at scale.
* Proven track record launching and scaling mobile and web applications with measurable business results.
* Strong grounding in product management, agile delivery, and API/integration architecture.

**Preferred certifications:**

Certified Scrum Product Owner/SAFe, PMP, AWS/Azure Solutions Architect, CISM/CISSP or equivalent security credential, ITIL 4.

title: Software Development Engineer - CFD
description:

Siemens Digital Industries Software is a leading provider of solutions for the design, simulation, and manufacture of products across many different industries. Formula 1 cars, skyscrapers, ships, space exploration vehicles, and many of the objects we see in our daily lives are being conceived and manufactured using our software.
  
  
Simcenter HyperMesh CFD is a powerful pre- and post-processing solution for Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD), designed to help engineers efficiently prepare models, generate high-quality meshes, and analyze complex simulation results.
  
  
We are looking for a Software Developer – CFD Post Processing to join our development team and contribute to the continued evolution of the Simcenter HyperMesh CFD (HMCFD) interface.
  
  
In this role, you will design, develop, and enhance GUI-based software capabilities used by engineers working with advanced CFD workflows. You will work closely with software developers, CFD experts, and users to understand technical requirements and translate them into intuitive, reliable, and high-performance software solutions.
  
  
The role provides an opportunity to work across C/C++, Python, Tcl, GUI technologies, CFD, and engineering software, while contributing to a product used in complex engineering workflows.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop core product capabilities: Design, implement, test, and enhance software features for the HMCFD graphical user interface using C/C++ and appropriate software engineering practices.
* Build intuitive engineering interfaces: Develop and maintain GUI functionality that enables engineers to efficiently prepare CFD models, interact with simulation data, and perform pre- and post-processing activities.
* Solve complex technical problems: Analyze user and product requirements, investigate technical challenges, and develop robust, maintainable solutions for complex engineering workflows.
* Develop automation and customization: Use Python and Tcl scripting to automate workflows, customize solutions, and improve productivity for specific CFD applications and user requirements.
* Collaborate across engineering teams: Work closely with software developers, CFD specialists, product teams, and users to understand requirements and deliver effective product capabilities.
* Ensure software quality: Perform development-level testing and QA activities, troubleshoot defects, and contribute to maintaining the reliability and usability of the product.
* Support product adoption: Contribute to technical documentation, user tutorials, and other technical content that helps customers and internal users effectively utilize HMCFD capabilities.

**Qualifications**

* Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Aeronautical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
* Strong hands-on programming experience in C/C++, with the ability to develop maintainable and production-quality software.
* Proficiency in Python and/or Tcl scripting for automation, customization, and engineering workflows.
* Experience developing GUI-based applications, with a good understanding of user interface design and software interaction patterns.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to understand complex requirements and translate them into practical software solutions.
* Working knowledge of both Linux and Windows operating systems and experience developing or supporting software in a multiplatform environment.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with software developers, engineering experts, and end users.

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience with Qt and/or OpenGL.
* Basic to intermediate knowledge of Computational Fluid Dynamics (CFD) and common CFD workflows.
