title: Product Engineer
description:
**About the role:**

We are building internal products that change how enterprise implementation work gets done. The products are live, in daily use, and growing. We are hiring experienced product engineers to build on them. This is a hands-on engineering role. You will pick up items from a live backlog, design the solution, build it, prove it works and ship it. The work spans the full stack, from data and services through to the screens people use. It suits an engineer who is comfortable owning something end to end, works well with an incomplete brief, and enjoys building tools that other professionals rely on to do their job.

**Job Location:**
Hyderabad, Bhubaneswar, Kolkata, Noida

**What you will be doing:**

•
**Delivering from the backlog.**
Items are raised continuously as the products are used and as new capability is needed. You take them, size them, build them and see them through to production.

•
**Building across the stack.**
Services, data model, integrations and user interface. You own the change from end to end rather than handing it across a boundary.

•
**Working with structured and unstructured data.**
Reading, transforming and validating data from documents, spreadsheets, exports and APIs, where the input is real and rarely clean.

•
**Integrating with enterprise platforms.**
Authenticating, reading and writing to business systems through their APIs, and handling the realities of rate limits, failures and partial results.

•
**Applying AI where it earns its place.**
Large language models are part of how these products work. You will build with them, measure them, and know when a deterministic approach is the better engineering answer.

•
**Proving the work.**
Automated tests, verified behaviour, and a release you can explain. Quality is part of delivery here, not a separate phase.

•
**Shaping what gets built.**
You will have direct input into priorities and approach. Experienced engineers here are expected to have opinions and argue them.

**Skills and experience**

**Commercial experience**
: 8+ years building and shipping production software, with meaningful time at senior level.

**Core languages:**
Strong TypeScript and JavaScript across back end and front end. Python or C# as a secondary language is welcome.

**Back end:**
Modern Node.js, API design, authentication, validation and error handling in a service you have run in production.

**Front end:**
React with modern patterns: function components, hooks, client-side data fetching and state. Clean, usable interfaces without a designer holding your hand.

**Data:**
Strong relational database skills. Schema design, real SQL, transactions, indexing and migrations. Comfortable modelling tables, columns, keys and relationships from a messy business problem.

**Data formats**
: Confident with JSON, XML, XPath and query languages, spreadsheet formats and document parsing. You can work with a schema you did not design and cannot change.

**Cloud:**
Building and running services in a major cloud, ideally Azure. Identity, secrets management, deployment and monitoring.

**AI engineering:**
Practical experience building with large language models: prompt design, structured output, validating what comes back, cost and latency as measured numbers.

**Engineering practice:**
Automated testing as a habit, version control discipline, and code that the next person can maintain.

***Highly regarded***

• Working knowledge of the Microsoft Dynamics 365 ecosystem and the Power Platform

• Familiarity with other enterprise business platforms such as NetSuite, SAP or Salesforce

• Experience with enterprise integration patterns and middleware

• Document intelligence, information extraction or natural language processing

• Reporting and analytics platforms

• Background in professional services or consulting, so you understand the people the products serve

title: Senior Quality Engineer
description:
**About StarRez**
StarRez is the global leader in student housing software, providing innovative solutions for on and off-campus housing management, resident wellness and experience, and revenue generation. Trusted by 1,400+ clients across 25+ countries, StarRez supports more than 4 million beds annually with its user-friendly, all-in-one platform, delivering seamless experiences for students and administrators. With offices in the United States, Australia, the UK, and India, StarRez blends the robust capabilities of a global organization with the personalized care and service of a trusted partner.
  
  
**About StarRez**
StarRez is the global leader in student housing software, providing solutions for on- and off-campus housing management, resident wellness and experience, and revenue generation. Trusted by 1,400+ clients across 25+ countries, StarRez supports more than 4 million beds annually. With offices in the United States, Australia, the UK, and India, StarRez blends the capabilities of a global organisation with the personalised care of a trusted partner.
  
  
**The Role**
StarRez Go is our staff-facing mobile companion to the main platform, used by housing staff to run inspections, check residents in and out, manage maintenance and look up resident information from the field, running on iOS and Android phones and tablets.
  
  
You will be the quality owner for the Go app. Your end users are staff on rounds, often on shared devices, using the camera and ID scanning, and handling student data. A failure in the field means a stalled check-in line or a missed inspection, so your quality approach will need to account for the end user
  
  
This is a hands-on role; you will not manage people. You will set the quality bar for the mobile team, do the work to hold it, and coach your peers in quality practices so that quality is baked in at every stage. The goal is a team that builds quality in, not a QA who inspects for it.
  
  
**What You Will Own**

* Own the end-to-end test strategy for the StarRez Go app
* You will set the quality bar for the mobile team, coach your peers in quality practices so that quality is baked in at every stage and raise it early when quality is slipping.
* Champion StarRez's quality standards and advocate for quality throughout the software delivery lifecycle.
* Design and execute validation strategies for feature-related initiatives.
* Partner with Product, Design and Engineering from ideation through delivery to ensure acceptance criteria, personas, customer journeys, test data, edge cases, non-functional expectations, and quality gates reflect real user operations and the intended product experience
* Decide what is automated, manual and exploratory, and be able to defend each decision.
* Own backward compatibility: older app versions remain in the field after a release. Define and test version support.
* Apply AI tools and techniques to improve product quality and enhance the effectiveness and efficiency of quality engineering practices and processes.

**Required Qualifications**

* 5+ years in software or quality engineering, with a deep focus on quality in complex systems.
* Hands-on experience testing native or cross-platform mobile apps on iOS and Android, including tablets.
* Experience testing mobile apps used in field or operational settings.
* Experience testing APIs and back-end services and the integration between a mobile client and its back end.
* Solid understanding of the testing pyramid, and of when UI automation and manual testing are each appropriate.
* Experience with cloud device farms or third-party testing platforms, and judgement about when outsourced tooling is the right choice.
* Practical experience with CI/CD pipelines and release quality gates, including test suite selection and environment readiness.
* Ability to turn customer needs into well-defined user stories, acceptance criteria and risk-based test scenarios.
* Practical experience using AI in software development, with sound judgement about where it helps and where it doesn't.
* Genuine curiosity about customer workflows and the business impact of engineering decisions.

**Desirable**

* Understanding of mobile security and data privacy, including device-level access control and handling personal data.
* Experience in SaaS, education, or property technology.
* Strong root cause analysis across client, API and infrastructure failures.
* Experience with mobile release processes: store submission, staged rollout, feature flags.

StarRez is an equal opportunity employer.

title: Senior Power Platform Engineer
description:
**Roboyo AI is a category shaper in Applied AI and Agentic Automation.**

We help leading enterprises move from automation projects and AI experiments into governed, production-grade systems that execute real work across workflows, processes, products and services.

 

Our heritage is in scaled enterprise automation; our future is Applied AI and Agentic Automation: autonomous agents, AI engineering squads, process orchestration, data and knowledge foundations, and human-in-the-loop governance embedded deeply into how our clients operate.

 

We are not here to sell AI theatre. We are here to turn AI into working systems, measurable outcomes and repeatable transformation programs.

 

**Job summary**

 

We are seeking a Power Platform Developer to join our Managed Services team and work with our clients to deliver high-quality business applications and automation solutions.

 

The ideal candidate will have 4-6 years of relevant experience in Microsoft Power Platform development, with a strong focus on Power Apps, Power Automate, integrations, application support, and continuous improvement. The candidate should be passionate about solving business problems through scalable, secure, and efficient low-code solutions.

**General: Responsibilities and tasks for this role**

 

* Develop and maintain Microsoft Power Apps applications, including Canvas and Model-Driven Apps.

* Design, develop, and maintain automated workflows using Power Automate cloud flows and desktop flows.

* Integrate Power Platform solutions with SharePoint, Microsoft 365, Microsoft Teams, Dataverse, SQL Server, and other enterprise systems.

* Design and implement third-party integrations using REST APIs, custom connectors, and web services.

* Develop reusable components and custom web resources to extend Power Apps functionality where required.

* Ensure timely ticket follow-up and resolution of L2 incidents within defined SLAs.

* Perform root cause analysis (RCA) for production incidents and implement corrective and preventive measures.

* Monitor application and workflow performance, proactively identify issues, and implement improvements.

* Handle change requests, enhancements, and bug fixes for existing Power Platform solutions.

* Collaborate with L1 support, development teams, and business stakeholders to resolve complex technical issues and translate business requirements into effective technical solutions.

* Coordinate operational support and maintenance activities for client accounts.

* Test and optimise Power Platform solutions for performance, scalability, reliability, and reusability.

* Follow Power Platform security, governance, compliance, and development best practices.

* Maintain technical documentation, including solution designs, configuration details, deployment guides, and support procedures.

* Provide clear and timely communication to end-users and stakeholders regarding incident resolutions, changes, and maintenance schedules.

* Support client onboarding and service transition activities by providing technical expertise, guidance, and knowledge transfer.

* Participate in the complete software development lifecycle (SDLC) and identify opportunities for process improvement and automation.

* Knowledge Sharing & Team Development: Train team members, share technical expertise, and guide Power Apps, Power Automate, and development best practices to support team growth and continuous improvement.

**Must-have qualifications & competencies**

 

* Minimum of 4–6 years of experience in Microsoft Power Platform development, particularly Power Apps and Power Automate.

* Strong experience developing Canvas Apps and Model-Driven Apps, including forms, galleries, reusable components, responsive layouts, and customisations.

* Proficiency in Power Fx, including advanced formulas, collections, variables, Patch, SubmitForm, data validation, and error handling.

* Experience with Power Automate cloud flows and desktop flows, including approvals, scheduled flows, automated triggers, expressions, loops, and exception handling.

* Good understanding of Microsoft Dataverse, including table design, relationships, data modelling, business rules, and security roles.

* Experience integrating Power Apps and Power Automate with SharePoint, Microsoft 365, SQL Server, and other enterprise systems.

* Strong knowledge of REST/SOAP APIs, HTTP actions, JSON, custom connectors, and third-party system integrations.

* Understanding of delegation, application performance optimisation, debugging, and troubleshooting using Power Apps Monitor and Power Automate run history.

* Experience with Power Platform solutions, managed and unmanaged solutions, environment variables, connection references, security, and deployment across development, UAT, and production environments.

* Good understanding of Power Platform architecture, governance, licensing, and DLP policies, along with experience in production support, root cause analysis (RCA), and continuous improvement.

 

**Nice to have qualifications & competencies**

 

* Experience with UiPath, Automation Anywhere

* Knowledge of Python, PowerShell, VBScript, or similar scripting languages

* Experience with AI/IDP tools (e.g., Document Automation, AI Builder)

* Exposure to CI/CD, DevOps, or ITIL-based service management practices

**Certification**

 

* PL-500 Microsoft Power Automate RPA Developer

  (Advanced/Master)

* Any RPA-related certification

**What we offer**

 

* Tailored development plan with career coaching

* Regular feedback – we value your opinion, and we appreciate new ideas

* Deepen your working knowledge of intelligent automation through our structured training courses

* Immerse yourself in an exciting, positive, and creative atmosphere and generate novel solutions to some of our client's most complex challenges

* Work in different international and cross-cultural teams for each project

* Candidate should have used Playwright and/or Selenium in previous projects and should be able to create and maintain automation test suites independently. Experience testing Android and/or iOS applications in real projects is also expected.
* Identify suitable manual test cases for automation and improve smoke and regression coverage through automation.
* Analyze automation failures and identify whether issues are related to application defects, test scripts, test data, or environment/configuration.
* Maintain reusable automation components, page objects, test fixtures, test data, and utilities.
* Integrate automated tests with CI/CD pipelines such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or similar.
* Generate and review automation execution reports and communicate failures clearly to the development team.

**Collaboration & Reporting**

* Work closely with developers, product managers, and business analysts to clarify requirements and resolve issues.
* Provide timely and detailed test execution status reports to the QA Lead / Project Manager.
* Support UAT by assisting business users and validating fixes.
* Work with developers to improve application testability and contribute to continuous testing practices.

**Quality Assurance Practices**

* Follow industry best practices for QA, including risk-based testing and defect management.
* Ensure compliance with organizational quality standards and processes.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of testing practices, automation coverage, and methodologies.

**Additional Expectations**

* Mentor junior testers by sharing knowledge and reviewing test cases and automation scripts.
* Take ownership of testing for assigned modules or projects with minimal supervision.
* Provide input for test effort estimation and project planning.
* Identify opportunities for test optimization and improvements in QA processes.
* Be able to explain automation framework design, locator strategy, waits, assertions, reporting, test data management, and troubleshooting of flaky tests.

**Key Skills Required**

* Strong knowledge of STLC (Software Testing Life Cycle) and SDLC (Software Development Life Cycle).
* Proficiency in writing test cases, test scenarios, and clear bug reports.
* Experience with defect tracking tools such as JIRA, Bugzilla, Mantis, or similar.
* Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodology.
* Good understanding of functional, regression, integration, UAT, smoke, sanity, and exploratory testing.
* Basic knowledge of SQL for backend data validation.
* Practical experience with Playwright or Selenium WebDriver.
* Hands-on mobile app testing experience on Android and/or iOS; familiarity with Appium or a similar mobile automation framework is an added advantage.
* Good understanding of Page Object Model (POM), reusable components, assertions, waits, test fixtures, and data-driven testing.
* Experience with at least one programming/scripting language such as JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, or Python.
* Basic understanding of API testing and API automation using Postman, REST Assured, Playwright API testing, or similar.
* Familiarity with Git/version control and basic CI/CD concepts.
* Ability to troubleshoot flaky tests and improve automation reliability.
* Understanding of when a test case should be automated versus kept as a manual test.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
* Experience testing across multiple browsers such as Chrome, Edge, Firefox, and Safari/WebKit, and across representative Android/iOS devices and OS versions.
* Experience with mobile app testing, including native/hybrid apps, WebView flows, device permissions, network conditions, app lifecycle, and release validation, is preferred.
* Familiarity with Android Studio/ADB, Xcode device logs, crash logs, or similar mobile debugging tools is an advantage.
* Experience running automation tests in CI/CD pipelines and generating test reports.
* Basic knowledge of performance, accessibility, or security testing is an added advantage.

title: Specialist - Software Engineering
description:
**Company Overview**
Acentra Health exists to empower better health outcomes through technology, services, and clinical expertise. Our mission is to innovate health solutions that deliver maximum value and impact.
  
  
Lead the Way is our rallying cry at Acentra Health. Think of it as an open invitation to embrace the mission of the company; to actively engage in problem-solving; and to take ownership of your work every day. Acentra Health offers you unparalleled opportunities. In fact, you have all you need to take charge of your career and accelerate better outcomes - making this a great time to join our team of passionate individuals dedicated to being a vital partner for health solutions in the public sector.
  
  
**Job Summary And Responsibilities**
**About the Job:**

As a .NET full stack developer in the healthcare industry, you will break down the features, estimate planning, and design. This role also involves developing, testing, and reviewing codes, mentoring team members, documenting, monitoring, and reporting status, and supporting product releases.
  
  
**What you will do:**
  
  

* Understand business requirements, perform end-to-end impact analysis, and liaise with business analysts to reduce ambiguity in requirements.
* Work closely with the solution architect to arrive at a high-level estimation.
* Prepare design documents and details at a component level. Breakdown the requirement into deliverable tasks.
* Estimate tasks and work with the technical leads in planning and sequencing.
* Research new technologies/components to meet business requirements and prepare technical documentation.
* Develop complex tasks and perform unit testing.
* Monitor progress, report status, and highlight risks.
* Modify and document new and existing program code to rectify errors or to enhance product capability.
* Mentor team members, render technical support, and perform code reviews.
* Prepare lifecycle documentation for newly created and existing software programs, including changes that reflect new user requirements and defect resolutions discovered after the testing phase.
* Own, develop, document, and implement system designs, codes, and testing standards.
* Analyze proposed changes at a system level and recommend designs and solutions that minimize the impact on interfacing systems while maximizing code re-usability and maintaining business value.
* Support the release manager and ensure to meet all the development checklists.

**Job Requirements And Qualifications**
**Education & Experience:**


* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, computer engineering, software engineering, or a related area, or equivalent experience, desired.
* 7 to 9 years of relevant experience in .Net technologies.

**Technical Skills:**
In-depth knowledge and demonstrable experience in the following technologies and methodologies:
  
  

* C#.NET, .NET6+, MVC.NET, Angular, or one of Bootstrap, ReactJS, VueJS.
* ASP.NET Web API, .Net core, JWT, OAuth2, JSON.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines, build automation, and release processes (Azure DevOps or similar tools).
* Microservices development and architecture.
* Good to have: MSTest, PL\SQL.

**Soft Skills:**


* Attention to detail. Dedicated self-starter with excellent people skills.
* Quick learner and a go-getter.
* Effective time and project management.
* Analytical thinker and a great team player.
* Strong leadership, interpersonal & problem-solving skills.
* Excellent communication skills are a must.
* Strong problem-solving skills and a creative mindset to bring fresh ideas to table.
* Should demonstrate confidence and self-assurance in their skills and expertise enabling them to contribute to team success and engage with colleagues and clients in a positive, assured manner.
* Should be accountable and responsible for deliverables and outcomes.
* Should demonstrate task ownership, meet deadlines, & ensure high-quality results.
* Demonstrates strong collaboration skills by working effectively with cross-functional teams, sharing insights, and contributing to shared goals and solutions.
* Continuously explore emerging trends, technologies, and industry best practices to drive innovation and maintain a competitive edge.

title: Lead, Tech (Private Credit)
company: D. E. Shaw India Private Limited
description:
The D. E. Shaw group is a global investment and technology development firm with more than $100 billion in investment capital as of June 1, 2026, and offices in North America, Europe, and Asia. Since our founding in 1988, our firm has earned an international reputation for successful investing based on innovation, careful risk management, and the quality and depth of our staff. We have a significant presence in the world’s capital markets, investing in a wide range of companies and financial instruments in both developed and developing economies.
  
  
The Private Credit Tech group at D. E. Shaw & Co. is looking for an experienced software developer to join our Tech team based in Hyderabad and Gurugram. This team is an extension of the firm's Private Credit business, based in the New York and London offices. The Private Credit business involves providing loans to private companies to facilitate capital for business growth, expansion, or refinancing existing debt. The Private Credit Tech team plays a critical role by developing the tools used by the business team for their daily workflows, working closely with the analysts to build analytical and operational tools that streamline pre- and post-trade business functions.
  
  
**WHAT YOU'LL DO DAY-TO-DAY:**
In this role, you will collaborate directly with the product manager, the desk (based out of US and UK), and the Financial Research team based out of our India office to understand their workflows and requirements. You will design, build, and own full-stack web application platforms spanning post-trade analytics, underwriting and modeling, and deal-sourcing workflows, driving projects from requirements gathering and architecture through implementation, testing, and deployment. A core part of the role is developing a deep understanding of the desk's point of view so you can propose sound technical solutions to real business problems, while balancing pragmatic, quick-turnaround delivery with designs that endure as requirements evolve. You will take end-to-end ownership of the systems you build and hold a high bar for both quality and timeliness, championing clean coding practices, thoughtful design reviews, and robust, performance applications. You will actively use generative AI tools to accelerate your own productivity across prototyping, coding, testing, and troubleshooting, and look for opportunities to apply GAI to unlock new capabilities and streamline business workflows. You will also partner with other infrastructure teams to deliver solutions that scale and contribute to a strong engineering culture through knowledge sharing and mentorship — with the opportunity to grow into leading a small team by next year.
  
  
**WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR:**
The ideal candidate should hold-
  
  
Basic qualifications:
  
  

* A bachelor's or master's degree in computer science or a related technical field, with an exceptional foundation in algorithms, data structures, and object-oriented programming
* 5 years of software development experience, with strong hands-on programming experience in Python
* Front-end development experience, especially in ReactJS/Redux, with the ability to deliver full-stack web applications
* Good SQL skills to understand the existing infrastructure and build new tools
* Technical and architecture design experience, with the ability to translate vague, high-level requirements into well-structured, coherent designs
* Hands-on experience using generative AI / LLM-assisted developer tools to accelerate development and automation
* Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills
* Excellent written and oral communication skills, and the ability to work effectively with both technical and business stakeholders
* The drive to learn about the finance domain and related analytics
* An interest in and aptitude for mentoring and leading a small team

Preferred qualifications:
  
  

* Prior experience in the finance domain, particularly in private credit, fixed income, or capital markets
* Experience owning projects end-to-end and driving them to completion

Interested candidates can apply through our website: https://www.deshawindia.com/recruit/jobs/Ads/Link/LeadTechPCJuly26
  
  
We encourage candidates with relevant experience looking to restart their careers after a break to apply for this position. Learn about Recommence, our gender-neutral return-to-work initiative.
  
  
The Firm offers excellent benefits, a casual, collegial working environment, and an attractive compensation package. For further information about our recruitment process, including how applicant data will be processed, please visit https://www.deshawindia.com/careers

**Android and iOS**
, using React Native and modern JavaScript/TypeScript technologies.

We need someone who combines strong frontend engineering capabilities with an understanding of mobile architecture, real-time communication, advanced UI/UX implementation and production application delivery.

  .

* Proven experience developing and maintaining
  **live mobile applications with real users**
  .
* Strong proficiency in

  .

  **push notifications, deep linking and notification-driven navigation**
  .

* Exposure to
  **VoIP calling or real-time audio communication**
  within mobile applications.
* Experience publishing, updating and maintaining applications on both the
  **Google Play Store and Apple App Store**
  .
* Understanding of client-side analytics, telemetry, event tracking and SDK integration.
* Experience debugging, profiling and optimising mobile application performance.
* Familiarity with Git, Agile development practices and collaborative engineering workflows.
* Strong problem-solving abilities and the confidence to independently deliver production-ready features.

**Highly Desirable**

* Backend development experience using
  **Go (Golang)**
  .
* Experience implementing
  **mobile-local Model Context Protocol (MCP) integrations and tool-calling capabilities**
  .
* Exposure to
  **client-side AI inference**
  , on-device models or mobile AI integrations.
* Familiarity with AI-powered applications, intelligent assistants or agent-based workflows.
* Experience with real-time communication technologies such as WebRTC.
* Experience with native Android (Kotlin/Java) or iOS (Swift) development.

title: Design System/UX Engineer
description:
At TTEC Digital, we coach clients to ensure their employees feel valued, and fully supported, because an amazing customer experience is an employee first process. Our vision is the same, a place where employees know they can thrive.
  
  
TTEC Digital seeks a Design System/UX Engineer to join our team. This role is a full-time and fully remote opportunity!
  
  
**The work:**
We’re an innovation group inside TTEC (NASDAQ: TTEC), building the next generation of AI CX tools — automated QA, conversational analytics, knowledge assist, and agentic automation — for the world’s biggest brands and the millions of customers they serve. We move like an early-stage startup, backed by the scale, distribution, and enterprise client base of a company that’s been obsessed with customer experience since 1982.
  
  
This is the rare seat where getting in early actually matters at scale. TTEC is a public company at an AI inflection point. Ship the right products into thousands of live enterprise deployments and you don’t just move a metric — you move the trajectory of the company and the value of the stock. The leverage is real, and the work compounds.
  
  
**Who we hire — the DNA:**

* Self-starters and do-ers with grit — hackers in the best sense, with a startup mentality and a show-me bias: working software over slides, prototypes over proposals.
* Want to learn, love new technology. This platform is built on the latest technology, and that technology changes and advances monthly. You adapt to change quickly — new tools, new models, new priorities — without drama.
* Master debuggers and problem solvers. You love solving complex problems, you think outside the box, and you multitask across domains without losing the thread.
* AI-native. You work with AI on all levels — you understand the technology around you (LLMs, SLMs, RAG, knowledge graphs, agents, training, eval) and you use AI tools daily to exponentially increase your velocity.
* Distributed-systems literate. High-efficiency, event-driven, low-latency systems are our world; you understand what that demands.
* Innovators who ship. You demonstrate ideas easily, fail fast, and move forward. You make committed timelines and hit them.
* You consider yourself exceptional — and you like winning. So do we.
* No one will have everything in this description. We're looking for well-rounded, smart people who move fast

**What You Will Do:**
**The role:**

* Own the design system in code and the UX of the wedge — the Agent UI shell, slide-out / pill, Control UI, and the per-module panels
* UX here ships as code, not Figma hand-offs. This is not a look-pretty job: the UI renders live voice, desktop, and AI event streams in real time, and you have to understand the technology underneath — events, WebSocket state, latency, plugin loading — so what you design flows and works, not just looks good
* Startup environment: 1-week sprints, Friday demos, fail fast, move forward.

**What you'll own:**

* The design system as a real component library — templates and patterns developers implement without friction
* Agent UI / Control UI interaction patterns
* Active Listening and Agent Handover UX
* The graphics language of the product (iconography, motion, data visualization)
* Accessibility (Lighthouse a11y > 90) and keyboard-first agent flows
* Your committed timelines.

**Who you are:**

* A self-starter with taste and grit — a designer who ships
* Show-me mentality: you demo working UI on Fridays like every other engineer
* You think from the developer's seat: every component you design, you've already thought through how the squads will implement, extend, and theme it — your design system makes them faster, never slower
* You love new technology, adapt fast when the product shifts weekly, use AI tools daily to multiply velocity, consider yourself exceptional, and like winning.

**What You Will Bring:**

* 7+ years of product design with real front-end engineering — you ship React + TypeScript, not just specs.
* Strong graphics experience — ++++ on visual craft: iconography, motion design, canvas/SVG data visualization, rendering dense live data beautifully and legibly.
* Has owned a design system as a living component library in a fast-shipping product — versioned, documented, themed, adopted.
* Strong templating discipline — reusable patterns and layout systems built for developer implementation; you understand component APIs, composition, and what makes a pattern cheap or expensive to build.
* Understands the tech underneath — WebSocket-driven state, event ordering, render performance, module federation/plugin loading — well enough that your designs never fight the architecture.
* Strong on dense, real-time, professional-tool UX (think trading terminals, not marketing sites) — an agent lives in this UI 8 hours a day.
* Accessibility and keyboard-first design as defaults, not afterthoughts.
* Perceived-performance craft — skeletons, optimistic updates, motion that masks latency; the UI must feel instant even when the network isn't.
* Design tokens as the theming backbone — enterprise customers will want branding; tokens make that config, not a rewrite.
* Overlay/extension constraints fluency — designing UI injected over a host page (pill, slide-out) with its size, z-index, and isolation realities.
* Usability evidence at startup speed — lightweight session recordings and agent feedback loops instead of month-long studies.
* A debugger in the browser — you profile the render, find the jank, and fix your own component.

title: Sr. Software Development Engineer, PCT Partner Connection Technology
description:
**Description**
Amazon's last-mile delivery network relies on thousands of independent Delivery Service Partners (DSPs)- small businesses whose drivers deliver packages to customers every day. We are looking for a Senior Software Development Engineer to shape the technical direction of the platforms that support the full driver journey: from onboarding and qualification to communication, recognition, and the tools DSP owners use to manage and grow their teams.
  
  
In this role, you will own the architecture and technical strategy across multiple engineering teams. You will lead large, cross-team initiatives from concept to production, design scalable distributed systems, and drive operational excellence across a global, regulated domain spanning 20+ countries. You will go wherever the problem is—including partnering with teams across Amazon—to deliver the right solution for customers.
  
  
This is a high-ownership role where you will balance hands-on engineering with strategic leadership, mentoring engineers, and influencing partner teams' roadmaps.
  
  

* Scope: Technical leadership across multiple engineering teams and production services.
* Technologies: Java, TypeScript, React, and AWS (Lambda, DynamoDB, ECS, API Gateway, SNS/SQS, CDK).

Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Own the technical strategy and multi-year architecture across multiple teams and platforms; author the design documents and technical vision those teams build against.
* Lead large, ambiguous, cross-team projects from concept to production; decompose them into milestones other engineers can own and deliver.
* Design and build secure, scalable, fault-tolerant distributed systems with robust authentication, authorization, and data-handling practices.
* Turn regulatory requirements from multiple countries into configurable, global solutions—partnering closely with product, compliance, and legal teams.
* Drive operational excellence through monitoring, root-cause analysis, deployment best practices, and continuous improvement of availability, latency, and cost.
* Mentor engineers across teams, contribute to hiring, and raise the engineering bar through code reviews, design reviews, documentation, and knowledge-sharing sessions.

A day in the life
  
  
You will work across teams and systems—connecting the dots and helping move things forward. That means design reviews, hands-on coding, debugging production issues, and pairing on APIs that power real-world driver workflows. You will collaborate with product, compliance, legal, and engineering partners across multiple countries. Beyond the roadmap, you might interview candidates, contribute fixes across codebases, support on-call, or run workshops to help fellow engineers grow.
  
  
**About The Team**
Partner Connection Technology builds the systems connecting Amazon with its Delivery Service Partners (DSPs)—independent small businesses whose drivers deliver Amazon packages. We manage the full driver lifecycle: onboarding, identity checks, vehicle/route qualifications, communication across email, apps, and messaging, and recognition experiences like customer-to-driver thank-yous. Serving DSP owners, drivers, and Amazon support teams in 20+ countries, our three engineering teams focus on absorbing complexity so small business owners don't have to—building configurable global solutions, not one-off fixes. The domain is regulated and fast-moving, with real architecture challenges and room to shape it.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
* 5+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 5+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**ECM Senior 1-3– Consulting**
EY GDS Consulting digital, is looking out for experienced web content management expert, especially on Microsoft Office365. Resource will be part of Enterprise Content Management team delivering to clients across regions.
  
  
**The opportunity**
We’re looking for resources with expertise in O365 development, implementation and related technologies to join the group of our ECM Collaboration Consulting team. This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm whilst being instrumental in the growth of our service offering.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Produces high-quality solution or infrastructure deliverables in accordance with project timelines and specifications, using sound coding and programming skills
* Performs coding, debugging, testing and troubleshooting throughout the development process contributing to moderately complex aspects of a project
* Maintains and enhances systems by fixing complicated errors, raising risks and escalating issues where necessary
* Works with users to capture detailed requirements, translating designs and solution architecture into design specifications
* Monitors and reports on potential risks/opportunities of emerging technologies, and seeks areas for continuous improvement
* Ensures all activities adhere to the relevant processes, procedures, standards and technical design
* Develop and promote best practices for usage, operations and development
* Strong analytical and communication skills with intense drive to learn and adopt.

**Skills And Attributes**

* 4-7 years development in O365 implementation.
* Must have strong analytical and technical skills using SharePoint SPFx, Python, C#, ASP.Net with MVC, JavaScript, and a variety of tools to deliver client-side solutions within Office 365.
* Strong knowledge in SharePoint Architecture Design (Extranet & Intranet).
* Must have good experience in SharePoint Framework (SPFx) & Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate) solutions.
* Good experience in JavaScript, Python, TypeScript, React JS, AngularJS, Fluent UI, Knockout JS, HTML5, CSS, Ajax, JSON, jQuery etc.
* Core Skills:

+ SharePoint: SPFx, PnP Framework, PowerShell
+ Power Platform: Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI, Power Virtual Agents
+ Dataverse: Data modelling, APIs, integration with Power Platform
+ Web API Integration: REST, SOAP, authentication (OAuth, OpenID Connect)
+ PCF Controls: React, Python, TypeScript, PCF control framework

* Desirable Skills:

+ Microsoft Purview: Data governance, DLP, information protection
+ Microsoft Syntex: AI-driven content processing, document understanding, classification, and generation
+ AI Builder: Custom AI models, integration with Power Platform
+ Microsoft 365 Copilot: Integration with M365 apps
+ Azure DevOps: CI/CD, source control
+ Microsoft Teams: App development, integration
+ Passion for the web, open source development, and for helping us build meaningful experiences.
+ Experience in consulting strongly preferred.
+ Strong problem-solving abilities, taking initiative, and the ability to thrive under pressure.
+ Maintain a positive and constructive outlook, focus on driving results, finding solutions / breakthroughs to solve problems and challenges; has a positive influence on peers.
+ Interpersonal and communication skills.
+ Respond positively to opportunities to be involved in brainstorming and iterative work. Handle times of change in a way that drives innovation and iteration.
+ Work in collaborative and supportive manner.
+ Listen carefully to provided information and ask clarifying questions. Actively listen as a learner rather than a passive recipient of information.
+ Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or related discipline preferred.

**Soft Skills**

* Excellent Communication Skills
* Team Player
* Self-starter and highly motivated
* Ability to handle high pressure and fast paced situations
* Excellent presentation skills
* Ability to work with globally distributed teams

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* A bachelor's or master's degree
* A minimum of 8+ years of experience, preferably background in a professional services firm.
* Strong knowledge of SharePoint 2013/2016/2019/o365
* Strong knowledge of SharePoint Framework (SPFx), Power Apps & Power Automate.
* Strong knowledge of TypeScript, React JS, AngularJS & Fluent UI.
* Strong knowledge of PowerShell & PnP.
* Excellent communication skills with consulting experience preferred

**Ideally, you’ll also have**

* Analytical ability to manage multiple projects and prioritize tasks into manageable work products.
* Can operate independently or with minimum supervision

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Software Development Intern
description:
We are looking for a motivated, detail-oriented, and technically curious Software Development Intern to join our Software Engineering team. The intern will gain hands-on experience in software design, development, debugging, integration, continuous integration and delivery, and AI-assisted software engineering while collaborating with developers and experienced engineering professionals.
  
  
Our intent is to develop an engineer who can understand the product and project end to end, translate customer and system requirements into reliable software solutions, evaluate modern development approaches, and contribute to the implementation of intelligent and AI-assisted engineering solutions.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Understand the product architecture, application workflows, customer use cases, technical requirements, dependencies, and engineering challenges across the complete software development lifecycle.
* Assist in designing, developing, enhancing, and maintaining software applications and components based on business and technical requirements.
* Write clean, readable, reusable, maintainable, and efficient code following established coding standards and software engineering best practices.
* Develop and integrate application features across frontend, backend, APIs, databases, and supporting services, as applicable to the assigned project.
* Participate in requirements analysis, technical discussions, solution design, code reviews, debugging, and implementation activities.
* Build and consume RESTful APIs and work with databases, data models, queries, and application integrations.
* Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve software defects, performance issues, integration challenges, and unexpected application behavior.
* Develop unit tests and integration tests to validate software functionality, reliability, and maintainability.
* Use Git-based version control workflows to manage code changes, collaborate with team members, and contribute to shared repositories.
* Work with Jenkins or other CI/CD tools to understand build processes, automated checks, deployment workflows, and software delivery practices.
* Explore modern development tools, frameworks, libraries, and architectural approaches to improve development efficiency and software quality.
* Prototype AI-assisted software development solutions using Large Language Models (LLMs), Generative AI, and AI agents for activities such as code generation, code review, documentation, debugging, refactoring, and test creation.
* Contribute to AI-enabled engineering workflows where software agents can analyze requirements, use development tools, generate or modify code, and validate outcomes with appropriate human review.
* Evaluate AI-generated code for correctness, maintainability, security, performance, and adherence to established engineering standards.
* Apply secure coding practices, investigate technical challenges, and recommend improvements to application performance, reliability, scalability, and maintainability.
* Document technical designs, implementation decisions, APIs, and development workflows to support knowledge sharing and long-term product maintenance.

**Qualifications**
**Required Skills :**

* Currently pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related field.
* Basic understanding of software development principles, data structures, algorithms, object-oriented programming, debugging, and software development lifecycle (SDLC) concepts.
* Working knowledge of at least one programming language, such as Python, Java, JavaScript, or TypeScript.
* Foundational understanding of application development, REST APIs, databases, SQL, source control, and software integration concepts.
* Essential exposure to and conceptual understanding of Large Language Models (LLMs), Generative AI, and Agentic AI, including their practical applications in software engineering.
* Ability to understand a system end to end, learn unfamiliar technologies, analyze problems logically, and translate requirements into practical technical solutions.
* Strong attention to detail, ownership, curiosity, collaboration skills, and willingness to experiment, learn, and accept feedback.

**Preferred/Nice To Have Skills**

* Hands-on exposure to frontend technologies such as HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Angular, or similar frameworks.
* Familiarity with backend development using Python, Java, Node.js, Spring Boot, or equivalent technologies.
* Experience working with relational or NoSQL databases such as PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, or similar systems.
* Familiarity with REST APIs, API integration, authentication, and application security fundamentals.
* Exposure to Git-based workflows and development platforms such as GitHub, GitLab, or Azure DevOps.
* Familiarity with Jenkins or another CI/CD platform, including build pipelines, automated checks, and deployment processes.
* Exposure to cloud platforms, containers, or development tools such as AWS, Azure, Docker, or Kubernetes.
* Experience with prompt engineering, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), tool/function calling, AI-agent frameworks, or model evaluation techniques.
* Understanding of responsible AI practices, including data privacy, security, hallucination risks, code validation, and human-in-the-loop controls.
* Academic, personal, internship, or open-source projects involving application development, full-stack engineering, AI-assisted coding, or intelligent software solutions.

**Who We Are**
Shure’s mission is to be the most trusted audio brand worldwide – and for over a century, our Core Values have aligned us to be just that. Founded in 1925, we are a leading global manufacturer of audio equipment known for quality, reliability, and durability. We engineer microphones, headphones, wireless audio systems, conferencing systems, and more. And quality doesn’t stop at our products. Our talented teams strive for perfection and innovate every chance they get. We offer an Associate-first culture, flexible work arrangements, and opportunity for all.
  
  
Shure is headquartered in United States. We have more than 35 regional sales offices, engineering hubs, distribution centers and manufacturing facilities throughout the Americas, EMEA, and Asia.
  
  
Join Shure and
**Amplify Your Impact.**
Explore our unique culture and learn the key pillars that define our legacy of excellence.
  
  
**THE MIX MATTERS**
Don’t check off every box in the job requirements? No problem! We recognize that every professional journey is unique and are committed to providing an equitable candidate experience for all prospective Shure Associates. If you’re excited about this role, believe you’ve got the skills to be successful, and share our passion for creating an inclusive, diverse, equitable, and accessible work environment, then apply!

title: Sr. AI-Native Application Engineer / Sr.Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE)
description:
**About The Ksquare Group**

The Ksquare Group is a global technology consulting company headquartered in Dallas, Texas, with over 14 years of experience delivering technology solutions across Salesforce, cloud, data, AI, and network engineering for clients in Banking & Financial Services, Public Sector, Telecommunications, Manufacturing, Logistics, Healthcare, and Enterprise Services. With a team of 350+ professionals across the US, Mexico, the Dominican Republic and India, we help organizations solve complex business challenges and achieve measurable outcomes through our collaborative POD-based delivery model. At The Ksquare Group, we foster a culture of integrity, collaboration, continuous learning, and professional growth, empowering our teams to make a meaningful impact for clients worldwide.

**Role summary**

We are looking for a Senior AI-Native Application Engineer who works as a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE): embedded with our clients, close to their users, data and systems. You will build and ship conversational and agentic AI applications end to end, from React or Vue.js front ends to Node.js, Python, Java or .NET back ends, and turn real customer problems into working software in production. You move fast, own outcomes, and feed what you learn in the field back into our platforms and accelerators.
 

**Key responsibilities**

* Build and ship fullstack AI-native applications using React or Vue.js front ends with Node.js, Python, Java or .NET back ends.
* Develop conversational AI and agentic AI features using LangChain, LangGraph or equivalent frameworks, including tool calling, RAG, memory and multi-step workflows.
* Integrate LLMs and managed AI services (OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Gemini, Vertex AI, Bedrock, Azure OpenAI) with client systems, APIs and data sources.
* Deploy and operate applications on GCP, AWS or Azure using containers, serverless and CI/CD, and own them through to production.
* Write clean, tested and well-documented code; take an active part in design and code reviews.
* Embed with client teams, on-site or remote; work directly with business users, SMEs and engineers to understand workflows, pain points and success criteria.
* Run discovery sessions and map client processes to identify high-value AI use cases; turn them into scoped, buildable solutions.
* Rapidly prototype and demo working solutions (POCs and MVPs), iterate on user feedback, and harden them for production.
* Work within the client’s environment: connect to their data, legacy systems, identity and security controls, and meet their compliance and governance requirements.
* Define and track success metrics with the client (accuracy, adoption, time saved, cost) and run LLM evaluations against real-world data.
* Own production support in the client environment; troubleshoot issues across the stack, prompts, agents and integrations.
* Drive adoption: train client users and teams, write runbooks and hand-over documentation, and enable client engineers to own the solution.
* Act as the voice of the customer: feed field learnings, recurring patterns and feature requests back to product, platform and practice teams, and turn them into reusable components and accelerators.
* Communicate progress, risks and trade-offs clearly to client stakeholders and internal leads.

**Required skills and experience**

* 4–6 years of professional software development, with solid fullstack delivery experience.
* Strong front-end skills in React or Vue.js (component design, state management, TypeScript).
* Strong back-end skills in at least one of Node.js (Express, NestJS), Python (FastAPI, Django), Java (Spring Boot) or .NET (ASP.NET Core).
* Minimum 1 year of hands-on experience building conversational AI and agentic AI applications using LangChain or equivalent frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, LangChain4j, Semantic Kernel).
* Working knowledge of LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, Gemini or similar), prompt engineering, embeddings, vector databases and RAG patterns.
* Must have cloud-native experience on at least one of Google Cloud, AWS or Azure.
* Mandatory hands-on DevOps experience, including CI/CD pipelines, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes) and production deployments.
* Experience in client-facing or customer-embedded roles; comfortable working directly with business users and non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong ownership and problem-solving: able to work through ambiguity, make pragmatic trade-offs and deliver independently.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Willingness to travel and work on-site at client locations as needed.

**Nice to have**

* Exposure to LLMOps tooling such as LangSmith, Langfuse or Arize.
* Exposure to one or more business domains (e.g., BFSI, healthcare, retail, manufacturing, logistics).
* Prior experience in a forward deployed, solutions engineering, startup or consulting role.
* Cloud certifications (AWS, Azure or Google Cloud).

description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Android Engineer**
**ConvergeSPORTS (USI) | Senior Consultant**
**About The Role**
ConvergeSPORTS is a product-driven business combining Deloitte's sports industry experience with proprietary data, AI-native decision intelligence, and reusable Converge capabilities. We help sports organizations grow revenue, deepen fan engagement, optimize partnerships, and improve commercial performance while operating with the focus of a product company. Our teams work with leagues, teams, venues, rights holders, media organizations, sponsors, and brands across fan data, digital experiences, and commercial analytics.
  
  
This role sits within the Mobile App product team. The ConvergeSPORTS Mobile App is a fan-facing digital product that brings together content, identity, engagement, personalization, notifications, and commercial experiences. The team owns the end-to-end fan journey and works with Architecture, iOS and Android Engineering, Backend Engineering, Data, Design, and Go-to-Market to deliver measurable releases.
  
  
This is a hands-on engineering role. You are the person closest to the Android codebase, accountable for the quality, performance, and stability of what fans actually experience on their devices.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Build the Android Experience**

* Design, build, and maintain native Android features for the ConvergeSPORTS Mobile App using Kotlin and modern Android architecture patterns
* Implement and consume RESTful APIs that power content, identity, personalization, and notification experiences
* Translate requirements, wireframes, and prototypes from Product and Design into production-ready Android code

**Own Quality End to End**

* Write unit and UI tests, participate in code reviews, and hold the line on code quality
* Optimize app performance, memory usage, and battery efficiency across a wide range of Android devices
* Troubleshoot and resolve production issues, using crash reporting and analytics to find root causes

**Ship as One Team**

* Work day to day with iOS and Backend Engineering to keep the fan experience consistent across platforms
* Manage Play Store release cycles, including versioning, staged rollouts, and crash monitoring
* Partner with Product and Design through sprint planning, reviews, and the daily calls that keep delivery moving

title: Software Development Engineer II, Amazon FinAuto - Travel & Events
description:
**Description**
The Amazon Travel & Events (AT&E) Tech team, part of Finance Automation, is driving a multi-year transformation of the end-to-end Travel & Expense experience for over 500,000 Amazon employees across 64 countries. We are consolidating previously fragmented travel, events, payments, and expense systems into a unified, AI-powered experience within AtoZ, organized around four interconnected modules: Plan, Book, Pay, and Expense. Our platform leverages machine learning, natural language processing, and GenAI to deliver context-aware policy guidance, proactive compliance recommendations, fraud detection, and sustainability intelligence embedded into employee workflows. The transformation eliminates significant administrative burden across the organization while delivering substantial cost savings and recovering employee productivity at scale.
  
  
We are seeking a passionate Software Development Engineer who can help us build the next generation of unified Travel & Expense systems and support the AT&E organization.
  
  
As a Software Development Engineer on the team, you will design and build services that power AI-driven policy guidance, intelligent booking experiences, automated expense workflows, centralized payment mechanisms, and real-time T&E analytics serving a global customer base. You will collaborate with product managers, data scientists, and senior and peer-level software engineers across Finance Automation and partner organizations including Accounts Payable and Global Corporate Procurement. This role provides you with autonomy and ownership over decisions, working backwards directly from customers. There is ample opportunity for growth due to the high-visibility work and presence of senior engineering talent for guidance and mentorship. The team operates in cross-functional two-pizza team structures that lead T&E technical transformations.
  
  
You will contribute to a three-tier AI architecture that answers employee policy questions in under 2 seconds with source references, and proactively surfaces policy-compliant recommendations during booking to prevent violations before they occur. You will build modern, mobile-first travel booking and Meetings & Events hub experiences across 45+ countries with real-time validation and calendar integration. You will develop guided workflows, automated data integration pipelines, and conversational agents that significantly reduce expense report submission time and eliminate a meaningful share of expense reports entirely. You will build virtual payment capabilities and central card automation that reduce out-of-pocket employee spend and target zero manual reconciliation. You will develop AI/ML-powered fraud detection models that automate the majority of investigation checks and support transaction-based detection across expanding payment avenues. You will build a single-source T&E analytics platform providing real-time spend insights, policy violation tracking, and cost optimization visibility for managers and finance partners.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Design and implement scalable service architectures that power AI-driven policy guidance, intelligent booking, and automated expense workflows for a global user base.
* Deliver working features across the full software development lifecycle, from requirements and design through implementation, testing, deployment, and operations.
* Collaborate with product managers, applied scientists, and engineers across Finance Automation and partner organizations to translate business needs into reliable technical solutions.
* Coach teammates through code reviews and design discussions, raising the quality bar for the team's software and establishing shared engineering best practices.
* Identify and resolve root causes of operational issues while continuously improving system reliability and maintainability.

**About The Team**
The Amazon Travel and Events Tech team sits within Finance Automation and is on a multi-year mission to unify how Amazon employees plan, book, pay for, and expense business travel and events worldwide. We are a collaborative, inclusive group of engineers, product managers, and scientists who value clear thinking and pragmatic design. If you want to build products at global scale that make a tangible difference in how people work, we would love to hear from you.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language
* Experience building complex software systems that have been successfully delivered to customers

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: Mobile App QA Intern
description:
Mobile App QA Intern — Flutter (iOS & Android)
  

**Purple Business | Mobile Application Testing & Quality Assurance**

**Company:**
Purple Business

**Website:**
https://purplebusiness.in

**Role:**
Mobile App QA Intern

**Department:**
Product Engineering & Quality Assurance

**Location:**
Remote / Flexible

About Purple Business

Purple Business is an AI-powered business growth platform designed to help small businesses grow through intelligent marketing, advertising, customer insights, and automation.

We're looking for a detail-oriented and technically curious
**Mobile App QA Intern**
to ensure our Flutter-based iOS and Android applications deliver reliable, intuitive, visually polished, and high-quality user experiences.

You'll work closely with our Flutter developers, product designers, AI engineers, and founders to identify issues, improve app quality, and support product releases.

Key Roles & Responsibilities1. Mobile App Testing & Quality Assurance

* Perform functional, regression, exploratory, integration, and usability testing of our Flutter-based iOS and Android applications.
* Identify bugs, crashes, performance issues, UI inconsistencies, and unexpected application behavior.
* Create detailed test cases, testing scenarios, checklists, and bug reports.
* Validate user journeys, onboarding flows, navigation, forms, and other core product features.
* Test application behavior across different devices, operating system versions, and screen sizes.
* Verify bug fixes and conduct regression testing before releases.

2. UI/UX & Visual Quality Testing

* Compare implemented Flutter interfaces against approved Figma designs.
* Identify inconsistencies in typography, colors, spacing, layouts, responsiveness, and visual hierarchy.
* Test animations, transitions, interactive components, and user feedback states.
* Identify usability issues and recommend improvements to enhance the overall user experience.
* Collaborate with the visual design team to maintain high standards of UI quality.

3. iOS & Android Environment Testing

* Test applications across Android and iOS environments.
* Understand platform-specific behavior, permissions, notifications, navigation, and device compatibility.
* Test app builds distributed through TestFlight, Android internal testing, and other development environments.
* Validate application behavior under different network conditions, interruptions, and background/foreground states.
* Identify platform-specific crashes, inconsistencies, and performance issues.

4. API, Network & Backend Testing

* Use tools such as
  **Postman, Charles Proxy, Proxyman, or similar tools**
  to inspect API requests and responses.
* Verify API integrations, authentication flows, error handling, and data consistency.
* Test application behavior during API failures, slow network connections, timeouts, and unexpected responses.
* Collaborate with backend developers to identify and reproduce integration issues.

5. Analytics, Performance & Crash Monitoring

* Validate analytics events, user interactions, screen tracking, and conversion funnels.
* Work with tools such as Firebase Analytics, Crashlytics, and other monitoring platforms.
* Identify performance bottlenecks, slow loading screens, memory issues, and application crashes.
* Test loading states, caching, and overall application responsiveness.
* Help ensure accurate event tracking across iOS and Android.

6. AI Feature Testing

* Test AI-powered workflows, generated content, and intelligent features within the Purple Business application.
* Verify that AI responses, recommendations, and generated outputs are displayed correctly within the UI.
* Identify AI workflow failures, unexpected outputs, loading issues, and error-handling problems.
* Develop testing scenarios for different user inputs, business use cases, and edge cases.
* Collaborate with AI engineers to report issues and improve the reliability of AI-powered experiences.

7. Test Documentation & Team Collaboration

* Maintain organized bug reports, testing checklists, and quality assurance documentation.
* Track issues and progress using Trello or other project management tools.
* Provide clear bug reproduction steps, screenshots, screen recordings, and device details.
* Collaborate with Flutter developers to verify fixes and prevent regressions.
* Participate in product reviews, testing discussions, and release planning.
* Share regular updates on testing progress, identified issues, and application quality.

Requirements

* Good understanding of
  **mobile application testing principles and QA methodologies**
  .
* Familiarity with Flutter-based applications and the iOS and Android ecosystems.
* Ability to write structured test cases, identify edge cases, and document bugs clearly.
* Understanding of functional, regression, integration, and exploratory testing.
* Familiarity with
  **Postman and network debugging/proxy tools**
  .
* Basic understanding of REST APIs, JSON, HTTP requests, and response codes.
* Strong attention to UI/UX details and ability to compare implementations against Figma designs.
* Familiarity with analytics, event tracking, and crash reporting.
* Good analytical thinking, debugging skills, and attention to detail.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with developers, designers, and product managers.

Preferred Skills

* Basic knowledge of Flutter and Dart.
* Experience with Flutter widget testing, integration testing, or automated testing frameworks.
* Familiarity with Appium or other mobile automation tools.
* Experience with Firebase Analytics, Crashlytics, or similar monitoring tools.
* Understanding of Git, CI/CD, and mobile release processes.
* Familiarity with Android Studio, Xcode, TestFlight, and Google Play Console.
* Experience testing AI-powered applications or API-integrated mobile products.

What You'll Gain

* Hands-on experience testing a real AI-powered mobile application.
* Direct collaboration with the Purple Business founding, engineering, and design teams.
* Exposure to Flutter development workflows, mobile testing tools, and release processes.
* Practical experience in functional testing, API debugging, analytics validation, and AI feature testing.
* Opportunities to contribute to product quality and user experience improvements.
* Mentorship and experience working in an early-stage product technology startup.

How to Apply

Share your resume, LinkedIn profile, and any mobile application testing projects or QA experience.

Candidates with experience testing Flutter applications, identifying UI inconsistencies, debugging API issues, or writing automated test cases are encouraged to apply.

**We're looking for someone who doesn't just find bugs, but understands how applications should behave, anticipates potential failures, and actively contributes to building a polished, reliable, and high-quality mobile product.**

title: Mobile App Developer
description:
**The Next Level of Fire & Life Safety Leadership**
With more than two centuries of combined history, brands like Kidde, Kidde Commercial, Edwards, GST, Badger, and Aritech have been leading the way in protecting people and property around the world. Now, we’re taking that leadership to the next level. Kidde Global Solutions brings together the most trusted and iconic brands in safety, building upon our shared experience and expertise to address the needs and challenges of more customers in more places. With an unmatched portfolio of solutions and services, and a commitment to constant innovation we’re elevating the standards for an entire industry – and establishing the next level of fire and life safety leadership.
  
  
At Kidde Global Solutions, you’re joining a global technology leader in fire and life safety solutions and our employees are the heart of it all. With industry-defining brands in life safety and security, you’ll be part of a legacy of leadership working with cutting-edge technologies that protect lives and property worldwide. As a leading fire safety brand, our mission is to provide solutions that protect people and property from the effects of fire and related hazards. We’re committed to expanding our impact and providing dynamic opportunities for growth within our team. You’ll be part of a company that prioritizes quality, integrity, collaboration, and customer care, with the resources, training, and incentives to ensure your success every step of the way.
  
  
Kidde Global Solutions is looking for an experienced mobile app developer to join the Aritech Engineering Team in Hyderabad. The role focuses on building, maintaining and modernizing Android and iOS apps used in security, access-control, video and intrusion products.
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
We are seeking a mobile app developer to maintain the Mobile app and help modernize it for future product needs. The app supports the Intrusion platform and the Security product range across Android and iOS.
  
  
The ideal candidate has hands-on experience with C#, .NET MAUI and mobile app development and can also support migration planning and delivery for Flutter-based mobile applications.
  
  
Technology Platform
  
  

* C#, .NET MAUI and .NET MAUI XAML.
* Android and iOS mobile development.
* Flutter and Dart for app migration and future mobile development.
* Visual Studio, Android tools and Xcode for development, debugging and release activities.

Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Develop, maintain and improve the mobile app for Android and iOS using C#, .NET MAUI and XAML.
* Support migration of existing mobile app features to Flutter, including UI, business logic, native integrations and platform-specific capabilities.
* Work with Security panels and security products using secure APIs, WebSockets and socket connections.
* Maintain the current binary protocol, including message handling, validation, reconnection and error recovery.
* Build app features for user management, alarms, events, status information, mobile control and remote access.
* Maintain secure WebViews, authentication flows, session handling and recovery from connection failures.
* Integrate native Android and iOS SDKs or plug-ins for video, notifications, secure storage and platform features.
* Troubleshoot issues across the app, native plug-ins, panel communications, networks, Android and iOS.

Security Responsibilities
  
  

* Implement secure communications using HTTPS/TLS, authenticated socket sessions and the encryption required by each panel generation.
* Maintain AES encryption, secure session establishment, message authentication, certificate validation and key handling where required.
* Protect credentials, tokens, encryption keys, certificates and sensitive user or security information using approved mobile secure-storage facilities.
* Validate data received through binary protocols, HTTPS APIs, WebSockets, notifications and WebViews.

**Required Technical Skills**

* Strong experience in C# and mobile app development.
* Hands-on experience with .NET MAUI, XAML, Android and iOS.
* Working knowledge of Flutter and Dart, especially for migration from existing native or .NET MAUI apps.
* Experience with HTTPS, WebSockets, TCP sockets, JSON and binary protocols.
* Understanding of mobile security, encryption, certificates, secure storage and authentication.
* Experience integrating native Android and iOS libraries, video SDKs, WebViews and push notifications.
* Good troubleshooting, testing and documentation skills.

Development Tools and Process
  
  

* JIRA for requirements, task management, defect tracking and release coordination.
* SVN for source control, branching, merging and release tagging.
* Jenkins for continuous integration, automated builds, testing, packaging and controlled release workflows.
* Visual Studio and the .NET SDK, together with Android and Apple development, testing, profiling and signing tools.
* Unit, integration and protocol testing, including simulation of Security panel communications.
* Code reviews, defect investigation, release verification and clear technical documentation.

Desirable Experience
  
  

* Security, access-control, alarm or building-control mobile applications.
* Direct communication with embedded controllers or security panels.
* Knowledge of security products.
* Video streaming, codecs, native multimedia SDKs or application-store release processes.
* Experience migrating apps to Flutter or building cross-platform Flutter applications.

**World Leaders in Fire and Life Safety**
Kidde Global Solutions is a world leader in fire & life safety solutions tailored for complex commercial facilities to homes. Through iconic, industry-defining brands including Kidde, Kidde Commercial, Edwards, GST, Badger, and Aritech, we provide residential and commercial customers with advanced solutions and services to protect people and property in a wide range of applications, all around the globe.

Location: Hyderabad, India

**Job Summary**

Practical experience with mobile functional, regression, and end-to-end testing.

Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.

Ability to independently execute testing activities and communicate findings effectively.

**Technical Skills**
– Preferred / Project-Specific

Candidates should have hands-on experience in relevant tools and technologies based on project requirements:

**Mobile Testing:**
Android, iOS, Appium, real-device testing.

API Testing: Postman, REST Assured, REST APIs, request/response validation.

**Low-Code Automation:**
Mabl.

**Database Testing:**
SQL queries, backend data validation, data integrity checks.

**Performance Testing:**
JMeter, load and stress testing.

**Defect and Test Management:**
Jira and related test management tools.

**Development and Scripting:**
Java, JavaScript, or other relevant scripting languages.

**Backend Testing:**
Service integration, business logic validation, database and API workflow testing.

**Agile Practices:**
Sprint testing, defect triage, test planning, and collaboration with cross-functional teams.

**Candidate Expectations**

Candidates must demonstrate practical, hands-on mobile application testing experience.

Tool knowledge must be supported by actual project experience rather than theoretical understanding alone.

Candidates should be able to explain their testing approach, test scenarios, automation scripts, API validations, SQL queries, and defects handled in previous projects.

Experience across multiple QA tools is an advantage, but candidates must be evaluated against the specific technical requirements of the assigned project.

Candidates should be comfortable with technical assessments and practical testing exercises during the selection process.
