**Position Summary**
**Mobile Test Engineer**
**ConvergeSPORTS (USI) | Associate Analyst**
**About The Role**
ConvergeSPORTS is a product-driven business combining Deloitte's sports industry experience with proprietary data, AI-native decision intelligence, and reusable Converge capabilities. We help sports organizations grow revenue, deepen fan engagement, optimize partnerships, and improve commercial performance while operating with the focus of a product company. The team owns the end-to-end fan journey and works with Architecture, iOS and Android Engineering, Backend Engineering, Data, Design, and Go-to-Market to deliver measurable releases.
  
  
This role owns quality for the fan-facing mobile experience across Android and iOS. You are the last line of defense before a release reaches fans, and the first person to know when something is not right.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Own Test Coverage**

* Design, write, and execute manual and automated test cases for new and existing Mobile App features
* Build and maintain automated UI test suites for Android using frameworks such as Espresso or Appium
* Validate API responses and data integrity across content, identity, personalization, and notification features

**Find and Drive Out Defects**

* Log, triage, and track defects through resolution, working with Engineering to reproduce and verify fixes
* Perform regression, exploratory, and smoke testing ahead of App Store and Play Store releases
* Monitor crash reports, analytics, and post-release quality metrics to catch emerging issues early

**Ship as One Team**

* Join sprint planning, backlog refinement, and release readiness reviews to define coverage and acceptance criteria
* Work day to day with Android and iOS Engineering, Product, and Design to clarify expected behavior
* Document test plans, results, and known issues so the team can act on them quickly

**Raise the Bar**

* Improve testing practices, tooling, and automation coverage over time rather than repeating manual effort

**Reporting Relationships**
Reports to Li-Shen Lee. Works as one team with Android and iOS Engineering, Backend Engineering, and Design, and partners with Product Management on release readiness.
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Required**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience
* 1+ years of experience in manual or automated testing of mobile applications on Android or iOS
* Experience writing and executing test cases and test plans
* Familiarity with at least one mobile test automation framework, such as Espresso, Appium, or XCUITest
* Ability to travel 0-25%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries you serve.
* Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

**Preferred**

* Experience with API testing tools such as Postman
* Experience with bug tracking and test management tools such as Jira and TestRail
* Exposure to CI/CD pipelines for mobile app testing
* Experience testing consumer-facing mobile apps in sports, media, or entertainment

**Core Competencies**

* Detail-oriented and methodical about reproducing and isolating defects
* Writes issues engineers can act on immediately
* Comfortable working across Android and iOS in a fast-moving environment
* Collaborative with engineering, product, and design
* Curious about mobile platforms and motivated to improve how testing gets done

**Why This Role Matters**
A single bad release costs fan trust that takes months to earn back. This role protects that, and it is a direct path into deeper mobile engineering and automation work on a product people use every week.
  
  
**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
  
  
**Our people and culture**
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
  
  
**Professional development**
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
  
  
**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. You will also be able to build tools and automate products, oversee the technical execution and business operations of Google's partnerships, as well as develop product strategy and prioritize projects and resources.
  
  
The Product Deployment Engineering Team for Measurement Services, gTech Ads GCS, provides exceptional complex measurement implementation for Google’s top GCS advertising clients. This team serves as the critical bridge between GCS customer business requirements and gTech Ads’ service and engineering offerings.
  
  
The core objective of the team is to unlock data foundations, specifically driving the adoption of complex Google data strength products (e.g., ECL, GTG). Team members collaborate with high growth customers on non-standard, complex environments to unlock business growth and defend business. To achieve this, PDEs conduct comprehensive audits and deep-dive sessions to diagnose technical environments, identify customer pain points, and enable product adoption.
  
  
Google creates products and services that make the world a better place, and gTech’s role is to help bring them to life. Our teams of trusted advisors support customers globally. Our solutions are rooted in our technical skill, product expertise, and a thorough understanding of our customers’ complex needs. Whether the answer is a bespoke solution to solve a unique problem, or a new tool that can scale across Google, everything we do aims to ensure our customers benefit from the full potential of Google products.
  
  
To learn more about gTech, check out our video .

title: QA Engineering
description:
**The Opportunity: Build the future of Wealth**

In a fintech world obsessed with gamification and speculative betting, Endowus stands apart. We aren't here to build another trading app; we are building the financial infrastructure to help people achieve long-term life goals - retirement, education, and financial freedom.

**Headquartered in Singapore, we are the largest independent digital wealth platform in Asia**
. However, we are not a one-trick robo-advisor. We are a full-suite wealth platform spanning public equities, fixed income, private markets, and hedge funds. We provide clients with customized exposure—global, regional, or sectoral—across all their wealth (from liquid cash to pension savings) and for all their needs (from short-term cash management to long-term retirement planning).

Just six years after launch, we manage over US$10 Billion (~₹90,000 Crore) in assets for more than a quarter-million clients across Singapore and Hong Kong. We are a Series B company backed by global giants (Lightspeed, Illuminate, Prosus, EDBI, UBS), with ambitions to cover the entire region.

**This is not an 'offshore' support role.**
Our India team is a
**core product hub**
, operating on parity with our Singapore HQ. Engineers here drive end-to-end ownership of platform innovation. You won't just be testing code; you will be engineering the safety nets that allow us to move fast without breaking trust.

**The Role: Engineering Confidence**

Most companies treat QA as a final checkpoint. We treat it as an engineering discipline.

Our clients trust us with their life savings. "Move fast and break things" is not an option here. What we need is "Move fast and prove it's safe."

Here’s what you can look forward to in this role.

* **Engineer the Safety Net**
  : You will build and maintain scalable automation scripts that cover the entire stack - from Backend APIs (Scala/Akka) to Web (React) and Mobile (Flutter). You ensure our regression tests are reliable and fast.
* **Shift Quality Left**
  : You will collaborate with Product Managers and Developers before a line of code is written. You will review requirements for testability and ensure edge cases are caught during the design phase.
* **Pragmatic Quality**
  : While automation is our north star, we value thoughtful test planning and the human eye. You are willing to roll up your sleeves and perform manual exploratory testing because you know when to automate and when to test/investigate manually.
* **Drive CI/CD Velocity**
  : You will integrate your tests into our CI/CD pipelines. You ensure that our feedback loops are fast so developers can fix issues immediately.
* **Guardian of the Client Experience**
  : You will look beyond functional correctness. You will simulate real-world client behaviors to catch usability friction, performance lags, and data inconsistencies that automated checks might miss.

**Our Tech Stack**

* **Web Automation**
  : We use
  **Playwright**
  for high-speed, reliable end-to-end testing of our React applications.
* **Backend Automation**
  : We use
  **Cucumber-Scala**
  to test our distributed microservices (Scala/Akka) and ensure our domain logic holds up under pressure.
* **Mobile Automation**
  : We leverage
  **Maestro E2E**
  and flutter tests for our Dart/Flutter mobile apps.
* **Ops**
  : We are 100% cloud-native (AWS) and rely heavily on
  **CI/CD**
  to run your tests on every commit.

**Want to look under the hood?**
Read how we solve testing challenges on our Engineering Blog at
tech.endowus.com

**What Success Looks Like**

* **First 30 Days (Immersion)**
  : You understand our domain models and testing infrastructure. You have added a new regression test and performed manual testing for a new feature release.
* **First 90 Days (Ownership)**
  : You are actively writing automated tests for new features within the sprint. You have built a deep understanding of many domain flows and have plugged several gaps in our current test coverage.
* **First 6 Months (Impact)**
  : You now own the test planning & execution for major new initiatives and are actively elevating the quality of our platform with a “founder mentality”.

**What You Bring (Requirements)**

We care more about your engineering intuition than your ability to memorize APIs. However, this role requires a specific baseline:

**Must-Haves**
:

* **4+ Years of Test Engineering**
  : You have solid experience in automation. You are comfortable writing code to test code, but you also respect the value of manual validation.
* **Strong Coding Fundamentals**
  : You are proficient in at least one major language (
  **Java, Scala, TypeScript, or Python**
  ). You can read developer code to understand where a bug might be hiding.
* **Automation Framework Competence**
  : You have experience using and extending frameworks like
  **Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium**
  . You can write stable, maintainable scripts.
* **API Testing DNA**
  : You are comfortable testing microservices. You understand REST, JSON, and how to query a database (SQL) to verify test states.
* **Collaborative Mindset**
  : You don't wait for a "hand-off." You actively ask developers and PMs questions about implementation details to plan your tests better

**Nice-to-Haves**
:

* **Mobile Automation**
  : Experience testing Flutter or native apps using Appium or Maestro.
* **Performance Testing**
  : Experience with K6, Gatling, or JMeter.
* **FinTech Domain**
  : You understand financial concepts, ledgers, or high-security environments

**Why Endowus?**

* **Modern Stack, Serious Business**
  : You get to apply modern automation tools to mission-critical financial infrastructure. You get the intellectual depth of a top-tier private bank with the agility of a startup.
* **World-Class Engineering Talent**
  : You will work with colleagues from top product companies like Amazon, Google, Swiggy, Flipkart, Grab, and Meta. We bring together strong fintech DNA with the best of agile startup culture.
* **Career Growth with Upside**
  : We manage massive AUA ($10 billion and growing) with a lean, high-talent team (~85 in product engineering). This means high visibility, high impact, and significant ESOP upside in a company that is defining the category.
* **Leadership Pedigree**
  : Our leadership team brings experience from Morgan Stanley, Goldman Sachs, UBS, McKinsey, Bloomberg, Amazon, Alibaba, Grab, Shopee, Salesforce, and more.

**Why NOT Endowus?**

We want you to thrive here, which means we must be honest about the environment.

* **You prefer 100% Automation**
  : If you thrive best when writing code all day and prefer to minimize manual exploration with the product or learning the domain inside-out, our hybrid approach might not suit you.
* **You prefer a Centralized QA Structure**
  : If you prefer working in a dedicated QA team with clear hand-offs from developers, you might find our cross-functional team structure (Backend + Frontend + QA + PM + Design) challenging.
* **You prefer executing over planning**
  : If you do your best work when given a pre-written test plan to execute step-by-step, this role might be too broad. We need engineers who can look at a feature spec and derive the test strategy themselves.
* **You want 100% Remote**
  : We work in the office at least 3 days a week because we believe in the serendipity of in-person collaboration

**The Interview Process**

We respect your time and aim to be thorough yet efficient.

* Recruiter Screen (30 min): Quick alignment on role, stack, and mission.
* Online Coding Assessment (90 min): A hands-on coding challenge to assess your coding and scripting fundamentals along with Test planning
* Technical Deep Dive (90 min): Live coding and discussion. We focus on automation logic, framework usage, and how you approach manual vs. automated scenarios.
* System Design (60 min): We talk about test strategies for distributed systems, API testing, and data management.
* Culture & Values (60 min): Meeting with Leadership to ensure we are a match.

**Company:**

Hyderabad, India (On-Site)

**Position Type:**
Full-time

**About the Role**

Drogo Aerospace is developing a next-generation, multi-node autonomy platform involving distributed vehicle intelligence, swarm coordination, simulation, autopilot integration, and server-hosted development infrastructure.

We are looking for a UAV Systems Integration & Verification Engineer to own system integration, simulation-driven testing, automation, and verification across these complex components. Your primary objective will be to ensure that independently developed software and hardware subsystems work together as a reproducible, fully tested, and reliable end-to-end system.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and maintain automated regression, integration, and system-level tests to validate software quality and system behavior across releases.
* Design and execute simulation-driven test scenarios to evaluate autonomy software under nominal, edge-case, and failure conditions.
* Build and maintain automated test frameworks, test harnesses, and utilities for simulation-based validation.
* Work closely with flight-control systems, onboard computing platforms, physics models, and software- and hardware-in-the-loop (SITL/HITL) testing environments.
* Validate multi-vehicle behavior, vehicle configuration isolation, interface contracts, message handling, timing, communication loss, and recovery behavior.
* Develop Python tools for test automation, telemetry analysis, data validation, and test-result reporting.
* Deploy, configure, and maintain the integrated software and simulation stack on Linux servers and virtualized environments.
* Identify, reproduce, and diagnose software and integration issues using source code, telemetry, logs, and repeatable experiments.
* Define comprehensive test plans, measurable acceptance criteria, performance metrics, and rigorous verification procedures.
* Integrate automated tests into development workflows and CI/CD pipelines to detect regressions early.
* Maintain rigorous test documentation, traceability, and verification results to support reliable system releases.
* Collaborate with cross-functional development teams to improve software quality, testability, and system reliability.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Strong Python programming skills and practical software-debugging experience.
* Hands-on experience in UAVs, robotics, embedded systems, or autonomous system integration.
* Deep understanding of automated testing, integration testing, regression testing, and systematic debugging.
* Working knowledge of Linux, Git, computer networking, and distributed applications.
* Ability to investigate complex issues across software, simulation, onboard computing, and hardware interfaces.

**Preferred Skills**

* Practical understanding of Software-in-the-Loop (SITL) and Hardware-in-the-Loop (HITL) testing workflows.
* Experience with simulation-based testing, automated test frameworks, or large-scale test execution.
* Working knowledge of onboard computing platforms and companion computers (e.g., NVIDIA Jetson, Raspberry Pi).
* Familiarity with CI/CD, Docker, virtual machines, and automated test infrastructure.

**Expected Outcomes**

* Establish a reproducible process for bringing up and validating the integrated system.
* Deliver automated tests covering critical subsystem interfaces and multi-vehicle behaviors.
* Create repeatable simulation scenarios with measurable pass/fail criteria.
* Provide clear diagnostic evidence and reports for failures and regressions.
* Build a reliable verification workflow that supports continuous development and progressively more realistic testing.

description:
**About NCR Atleos**
NCR Atleos, headquartered in Atlanta, is a leader in expanding financial access. Our dedicated 20,000 employees optimize the branch, improve operational efficiency and maximize self-service availability for financial institutions and retailers across the globe.

**Location: Hyderabad**

**About**
**About NCR ATLEOS Corporation:**
NCR ATLEOS is the global leader of self-service interactions we are at the forefront of turning everyday transactions into exceptional experiences and making every day easier. NCR ATLEOS’s footprint extends over a wide spectrum of areas: from point-of-sale terminals to ATMs, from financial and retail management systems to global payment systems. The industry is changing at an incredible rate with the arrival of new and disruptive technologies and startups, and we want you to be a part of it. This is an exciting time to get involved in the new products and solutions that NCR ATLEOS is developing for this rapidly changing world, applying the latest technologies and development practices.
  
  
**About The Role**
The Channel Management team is responsible for creating multiple enterprise applications, in a scaled agile environment, to assist in the management of self-service devices (e.g. ATMs, retail self check-out machines, hospitality self check-in kiosks, etc). Our applications focus on the management of these endpoints, and cover: Inventory Management, Software Distribution, Device Management, automated Help Desk Workflows, and associated Business Intelligence. The successful applicant will contribute to the delivery of on premise/SaaS based Enterprise Web Applications to the Financial, Hospitality and Retail lines of business.
  
  
We are looking for enthusiastic engineers, with differing levels of experience in developing full-stack Enterprise Java applications, to add momentum to the creation of NCR ATLEOSs next generation of Channel Management products. The successful candidates must be able to contribute to the implementation of user stories across the technology stack.
  
  
**To Be Successful We Need People Who**

* 3-6 years of experience in software design and development
* Enthusiastically follow technology trends, software engineering best practices and technologies
* Take pleasure in seeing smart, practical solutions put in front of customers
* Enjoy the challenge of solving complex problems
* Are open to constantly refresh and renew their skills.

**Responsibilities**

* Contribute in all phases of the development lifecycle
* Development and review of changes with a focus for design, efficiency, and quality
* Work as part of a team as well as working autonomously
* Contribute to improvements to the software development process
* Support continuous improvement by investigating alternatives and technologies and presenting these for review

**Requirements**

* BS/MS degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related subject
* Experience developing in an Agile environment, using current engineering best practices
* Experience using - CSS3, HTML5, JavaScript
* Experience with at least one MVC Framework – e.g. Angular.js, Angular, or React
* Experience using jsp, servlets, Java 8, Spring, Spring boot Framework, JPA/Hibernate, JUnit
* Experience using a RDBMS – e.g., SQL (MS SQL Server, Oracle)
* Experience in with Git, Docker and Kubernetes
* Experience with any one Cloud AZURE, AWS or GCP (IAAS, PAAS & SAAS)
* Knowledge on Docker and CI/CD pipelines

**AI/GenAI**

* Seeking a hands-on AI Engineer with experience building and deploying AI-powered applications, agents, and automations using LLMs.
* Must have expertise in RAG, prompt engineering, MCP/agent frameworks, model evaluation, and integrating AI solutions with APIs, data sources, and enterprise systems.
* Strong knowledge of open-source AI ecosystems (LangChain, Llama Index, Hugging Face, vector databases) and AI reliability best practices is required.

title: Senior Power Platform Engineer 2
description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**
At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI-enabled insights and technology-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.
  
  
**Job Description:**
The Senior Power Platform Engineer 2 role works within our agile/scrum Product Engineering team to contribute to major engineering initiatives. This role is leading initiatives they often establish with limited guidance to the definition of done, working with immediate peers, and communicating on a team-wide level.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**

* Applying current and learning new technical skills and understanding required to complete often technically more difficult tasks to the definition of done.
* Conducts and facilitates code reviews at times ensuring coding standards are being met.
* Writes technical documentation for application development.
* Maintains in-depth knowledge of all the applications and code worked on, even code not written by the individual.
* Conducts Proof-of-Concepts for new solutions and/or technologies when asked and provides pro/con inputs to the team for decision making.
* Identifies, owns, and ensures implementation of work process improvement concepts.

**Qualifications/Requirements:**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, MIS, Information Systems or engineering fields, MCA, or equivalent experience.
* Excellent oral and written communications skills.
* 5 – 8+ years of relevant experience.
* Understanding of object-orient programming (OOP) and Design Patterns.
* 3+ years of experience with C#, HTML, CSS, JS / jQuery.
* Experience with model-driven Power Apps customizations with advanced configurations.
* Experience with Power Platform development via Plugins / Workflows / Actions concepts.
* Experience with SQL Server Reporting Services and / or Power BI reporting concepts.
* Experience with Dynamics 365 / Dataverse Product Modules (Sales/Marketing/Service/Field Service).
* Understanding of Power Apps Solution Management concepts.
* Understanding of Power Apps Security Management Concepts (security, roles, privilege, teams, access team, field level security).
* Experience with data migration (SSIS packages using Kingsway, Power Platform Data Import Wizard, Microsoft Fabric, or custom console app).
* Excellent Debugging Skills.
* Experience working with Power Automate (MS Flow).
* Experience working with MS Portal / Power Portal / Power Pages.
* Experience with using Azure services such as Service Bus, Azure SQL Database, Azure Data Factory, Azure Functions, API Manager, and Azure App Services.
* 3+ years of experience working and delivering in Agile.
* Experience leveraging Azure DevOps (ADO) or Jira for work item management, as well as Git for version control.
* Experience with a JavaScript framework such as React, Angular, Vue, or similar, a plus.
* Experience with CI/CD automation for automated solution deployment, a plus.
* VS Unit testing, a plus.
* Technology certifications, a plus.

**Skills:**

* Communication - Communicates with organization. Helps others in the team to communicate.
* Empathy & Humility - Constantly pushes for a better understanding of the needs and perspectives of those outside your viewpoint. Makes sound design/coding decisions keeping customer in the forefront.
* Initiative – Uses your own judgment to make decisions without asking another person's advice.
* Objectivity & Adaptability - Takes problems outside your skillset and quickly adapts to solve them. Helps peers do the same.
* Growth Mindset – Actively looks for opportunities to try and learn new things. Hungry to try new tools and techniques or try new areas of the business to test yourself.
* Writing Code – Consistently writes production-ready code across complex products. You are regularly trusted to lead complex and business-critical coding including guiding others.
* Testing – Independently tests and advises the rest of the team on quality of tests.
* Debugging & Monitoring – Uses systematic debugging to diagnose all issues located to a single service and drives monitoring work across the team.
* Technical Understanding & Prioritization – Is a technical and prioritization leader within the team, including taking some ownership of other team members' technical growth and development.
* Security – Consistently approaches all engineering work with a security lens.
* Software Architecture – Has a good understanding of, and designs functions that are aligned with, the overall service architecture. You understand changes may have effect beyond the immediate change. Also understands changes may impact external integrations and / or other dependencies and is conscious to plan and communicate accordingly.
* Business Context – Understands how the business works and the goals of the team. Can relate that to their own work.
* Product Knowledge – Has a detailed understanding of areas of the product.
* Culture & Togetherness – Is conscious of signaling and tries to act as you expect other team members to act. Works to develop good positive relationships. Participates in team activities.
* Developing Others – Recognizes strengths of peers and looks for ways to support those strengths through project work. Invests time in materials or processes to support team growth. Peers see you as an informal coach.
* Hiring & Org Design – A competent interviewer. Follows a structured hiring process and contributes to a decision.
* Stakeholder Management – Known for being efficient and reliable, and doing what you say you will do. Proactively manages expectations even when it results in frustration or personal reputation risk.
* Team Leadership – Capable of informally managing interns and other staff. Possibly manages one or two junior team members. Does not look for glory and does not complain about work that needs to be done. Assumes good decisions in others' work. Broadly, you do what you say you are going to do.

We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe’s values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times.

At Crowe, we know that great people are what makes a great firm. We value our people and offer employees a comprehensive benefits package. Learn more about what working at Crowe can mean for you!
  
  
**How You Can Grow:**
We will nurture your talent in an inclusive culture that values diversity. You will have the chance to meet on a consistent basis with your Career Coach that will guide you in your career goals and aspirations. Learn more about where talent can prosper!
  
  
**More about Crowe:**
Crowe Capability Center – India, operating under the legal entity C3 India Delivery Centre LLP (formerly known as Crowe Horwath IT Services LLP) is a wholly owned subsidiary of Crowe LLP (U.S.A.), a public accounting, consulting and technology firm with offices around the world. title: Oracle OIC and VBCS Consultant
description:

• Effective interpersonal skills (written and spoken) and strong problem-solving skills
  
  
• Ability to work in a fast-paced Agile development and rapid deployment in the Student Cloud/SaaS environment
  
  
• Strong inclination towards test driven development
  
  
• Great teammate, able to work with different levels in the organization across multiple time zones.

• Experience building features with technologies including Oracle Cloud Fusion, OICS, REST services, PL/SQL, Python, Java, and VBCS.
  
  
• Solid understanding in finance business process functions, including R2R, P2P, O2C and Oracle RMB.
  
  
• Data modelling, designed and implemented ETL interfaces/mappings to load data into DWH as per business and reporting requirements
  
  
• Very good knowledge and expertise following industry standard processes/methods like Agile, DevOps, and SDLC.
  
  
• Certifications: Relevant Oracle OICS certifications, such as Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) certifications or Oracle Fusion Applications certifications.

• Experience and skill in leading virtual teams, partnering across interpersonal boundaries, influencing development direction and the ability to empower, grow and guide developers.
  
  
  
  
Experience
  
  
• Knowledge of Oracle Cloud Fusion, OICS, BIP Reporting, REST services, Java, ADF, SOA, PL/SQL, Paython, Java and VBCS, Oracle Database ADW Applications Seeded Customization Framework, OATs. PSR Tools, Accessibility Testing Tools preferred

• Experience handling Oracle ERP Cloud Fusion Applications infrastructure and leading end to end operations for change control boards

• Experience working within a Finance Technology function, preferably with large Financial Services Organisation.

• Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent.

**Job Description**
**Sr. Spclst , Software Engineering**
**The Opportunity**

* Based in Hyderabad, join a global healthcare biopharma company and be part of a 130- year legacy of success backed by ethical integrity, forward momentum, and an inspiring mission to achieve new milestones in global healthcare.
* Be part of an organisation driven by digital technology and data-backed approaches that support a diversified portfolio of prescription medicines, vaccines, and animal health products.
* Drive innovation and execution excellence. Be a part of a team with passion for using data, analytics, and insights to drive decision-making, and which creates custom software, allowing us to tackle some of the world's greatest health threats.

Our Technology Centers focus on creating a space where teams can come together to deliver business solutions that save and improve lives. An integral part of our companys’ IT operating model, Tech Centers are globally distributed locations where each IT division has employees to enable our digital transformation journey and drive business outcomes. These locations, in addition to the other sites, are essential to supporting our business and strategy.

* Software development on backend (Python,TypeScript) and frontend (TypeScript/JavaScript - React framework).

* Deploy solutions on the cloud with CI/CD integration.
* Deliver enterprise AI projects, products, and platforms with a focus on scalability and reusability.
* Work on technical pilots and feasibility studies of new opportunities to create value and transitioning successful pilots to scalable production implementations.
* Develop integrations with other applications and services.
* Develop automated testing pipelines.
* Application release and second level support.

title: Senior Manager, App Dev & Support
description:
Through our dedicated associates, Conduent delivers mission-critical services and solutions on behalf of Fortune 100 companies and over 500 governments - creating exceptional outcomes for our clients and the millions of people who count on them. You have an opportunity to personally thrive, make a difference and be part of a culture where individuality is noticed and valued every day.
  
  
**Job Description:**
**Senior Technical Architect (Application Modernization)**
We are seeking a visionary Technical Architect with a deep background in Application Modernization to lead a critical digital transformation. This role is focused on deconstructing a legacy 2-tier architecture and rebuilding it into a scalable, high-performance N-tier system.
  
  
You will be the bridge between the past and the future—moving our logic out of SQL stored procedures and migrating our legacy C# frontend into a modern, responsive React/Redux ecosystem.
  
  
**Core Responsibilities**

* Architectural Strategy: Define the roadmap for migrating a monolithic 2-tier application (Client/Server) to a decoupled, N-tier architecture.
* Legacy Deconstruction: Analyze legacy C# codebases and complex SQL stored procedures to identify business logic for extraction.
* Modernization Execution: Lead the shift of business logic from the database layer into a dedicated C#/.NET Business Logic Layer (BLL) or Microservices.
* Frontend Leadership: Direct the transition from legacy UI to a modern React.js frontend, utilizing Redux for robust state management using Vite, Material UI, Redux Toolkit, React Query, React Hook Form, and Styled Components/SCSS.
* Ensure cross-browser compatibility, visual consistency, and WCAG accessibility compliance.
* API Design: Architect and implement secure, RESTful APIs that serve as the communication backbone between the new frontend and the re-engineered backend.
* Technical Governance: Establish coding standards, design patterns (e.g., Repository, Unit of Work), and CI/CD pipelines tailored for modernization projects.

**Technical Requirements**
Category Requirements Modernization Proven experience moving logic from Stored Procedures to Application Code (Refactoring the "Smart Database" anti-pattern). Frontend Expert-level proficiency in React.js, Redux / Redux Toolkit, Vite, Material UI, React Query, React Hook Form, and Styled Components/SCSS and modern CSS frameworks (Bootstrap). Backend Strong mastery of C# and .NET (6/7/8/9+), specifically in building Web APIs and Service Layers (must have strong hands-on experience in RestSharp, Dapper, Fluent Validations etc.). Database Deep understanding of SQL Server; ability to read/debug complex legacy T-SQL and optimize new schemas. Architecture Solid grasp of N-tier architecture, Dependency Injection, and Microservices patterns. Cloud/Containerization Expert-level proficiency in Cloud (Azure), Docker and Kubernetes. Cache Mechanism Strong mastery in Redis for Cache Management
  
  
**Experience & Qualifications**

* Modernization Veteran: 15+ years of experience in software engineering, with at least 5+ years specifically leading Legacy-to-Modern migration projects.
* The "2-to-N" Specialist: Demonstrated success in breaking down 2-tier "Fat Client" or "Fat DB" systems into modular N-tier environments.
* Strategic Thinker: Ability to balance "perfect" architecture with business continuity.
* Communication: Ability to explain technical debt and architectural ROI to stakeholders who may only see the UI changes.
* Industry certifications would definitely be considered.

Conduent is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers applicants for all positions without regard to race, color, creed, religion, ancestry, national origin, age, gender identity, gender expression, sex/gender, marital status, sexual orientation, physical or mental disability, medical condition, use of a guide dog or service animal, military/veteran status, citizenship status, basis of genetic information, or any other group protected by law.

Complete the form and then email it as an attachment to FTADAAA@conduent.com. You may also click here to access Conduent's ADAAA Accommodation Policy.

title: Software Development Engineer, Time & Pay Innovation
description:
**Description**
Amazon is one of the largest employers on the planet with hundreds of thousands of employees across the globe. Come join us in our journey to deliver solutions for one of the most complex domains in People eXperience Technology (PXT). Your code determines how Amazon associates get paid — accurately, on time, every single day. As an SDE-II in TAA, you own and deliver features across one of Amazon's most critical real-time platforms: a high-throughput, event-driven architecture processing millions of IoT punch events globally. You don't just write code — you own systems. We own and deliver technology to manage employee time expectations and compute their pay, globally, for all our current and emerging businesses. At the core, we are in the business of analytics — real-time and event-driven — of data collected from IoT devices (time clocks) and web user interfaces. We own our own high-availability services to support this processing, and require the ability to work from replay-able, auditable "truth" for any point in an employee's timeline. Our business rules are complex and arcane, varying by role, business, and jurisdiction. We are solving all these problems at Amazon scale, an order of magnitude larger than supported by any commodity solutions and growing exponentially.
  
  
We are looking for a Software Development Engineer II who is a strong, independent builder with growing design maturity. You take ownership of significant features and components, drive them from design through production, and operate them with high standards. You write high-quality code, make sound technical decisions with appropriate trade-offs, and proactively improve the systems you touch. You are developing your ability to influence design direction, mentor junior engineers, and think beyond your immediate deliverables to the health of the broader system.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Own the design and delivery of significant features and components across scalable, multi-tiered applications and services. Drive projects from requirements through design, implementation, testing, deployment, and production operation.

Write high-quality, well-tested production code using modern languages, design patterns, and frameworks. Hold yourself and your peers to high standards through thorough code reviews.
  
  

* Make sound technical decisions with appropriate trade-offs. Evaluate options for caching, retry strategies, concurrency, and data modeling. Justify your choices and communicate trade-offs clearly.

Design and build for scale and resilience. Consider failure modes, rate limits, traffic bursts, and downstream dependency health in your designs. Implement patterns like backpressure, circuit breakers, and graceful degradation.
  
  

* Own operational excellence for your systems. Monitor production health, respond to alarms, investigate root causes, and drive fixes. Write runbooks, improve observability, and reduce operational burden over time.

Contribute to system-level design discussions. Participate actively in design reviews — propose solutions, challenge assumptions, and help the team arrive at better architectures.
  
  
Mentor junior engineers. Support SDE-Is through code reviews, pairing sessions, and technical guidance. Help them grow their skills and develop good engineering habits.
  
  

* Understand and translate business requirements. Work with stakeholders to understand complex domain rules across punch processing, attendance, scheduling, and compliance. Turn ambiguous requirements into clear technical designs.

Identify and resolve technical debt proactively. Improve code quality, simplify complex logic, optimize performance, and refactor systems to support future growth — without being asked.
  
  
Contribute to team processes and culture. Participate in sprint planning, retrospectives, and on-call rotations. Raise the bar for engineering practices and help improve team velocity.
  
  
A day in the life
  
  
You start the day reviewing a design you wrote for a new feature in the compliance system — incorporating feedback from a senior engineer on edge cases around jurisdiction-specific rules. You update the design, get alignment, and start building. Mid-morning, you review a code change from a junior engineer, leaving constructive feedback on error handling and test coverage. After lunch, you investigate a latency spike in one of your services — tracing requests through logs and metrics, identifying a downstream throttling issue, and implementing a retry optimization. You join a design review for a cross-team project, asking questions about failure modes and proposing an alternative caching approach. You close the day deploying your feature to a pre-production environment, validating metrics, and updating the team on progress in standup.
  
  
**About The Team**
We are Time and Attendance (TAA) team within People eXperience Technology (PXT). Our team builds and operates the technology that powers how Amazon tracks, manages, and compensates employee time — globally, across all business lines and geographies.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* 1+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience
* 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience
* 1+ years of Object Oriented Design experience
* Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

You’ll help define the technical direction, scalability, and architecture of DAZN’s Android and Android TV applications — platforms that handle massive concurrency, real-time delivery, and unmatched video performance.

Join us to shape the future of streaming technology while making a global impact.

Role Overview

As an Android Architect, you will lead the design and architecture of DAZN’s Android. You’ll collaborate with cross-functional teams to define scalable solutions, ensure technical excellence, and evolve the platform to meet DAZN’s global growth and innovation goals.

You will be hands-on in setting coding standards, mentoring developers, and driving architectural decisions for performance, maintainability, and reliability.

Key Responsibilities

· Lead the architecture, design, and implementation of Android and Android TV applications.

· Define best practices, frameworks, and reusable components to ensure consistency and scalability across teams.

· Partner with product, design, and backend engineering teams to translate business needs into robust, high-performance solutions.

· Drive technical design reviews, performance optimization, and system scalability improvements.

· Architect integrations with APIs, content delivery systems, and playback pipelines (HLS, DRM, adaptive streaming).

· Ensure security, resiliency, and maintainability of applications through strong architectural governance.

· Guide teams on modern Android patterns (MVVM, MVI, Clean Architecture) and Jetpack Compose adoption.

· Contribute to DAZN’s engineering culture, mentoring engineers and fostering innovation.

Required Skills & Experience

· 8+ years of Android application development experience, including 4+ years in architecture or lead engineering roles.

· Strong hands-on background in Kotlin and Java.

· Proven experience architecting and building apps for Android and Android TV.

· Expertise in video streaming, playback, and DRM integration (ExoPlayer, HLS, DASH).

· Solid understanding of software design patterns (MVC, MVVM, MVI) and SOA / RESTful architecture.

· Experience with CI/CD pipelines, modularization, and scalable multi-module app design.

· Strong understanding of performance tuning, memory management, and concurrency in Android.

· Experience working in Agile environments with distributed teams.

Nice to Have

· Experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Firebase, and event-driven microservices.

· Knowledge of broadcast systems, digital video workflows, or metadata pipelines.

· Familiarity with Jetpack libraries, Compose for TV, and AndroidX TV UI components.

· Experience designing for large-scale, high-availability applications.

· Passion for sports, media technology, and cutting-edge user experiences.

Why Join DAZN

· Work on globally distributed, large-scale streaming systems used by millions.

· Influence the architecture and future of DAZN’s Android ecosystem.

· Be part of a culture that values innovation, ownership, and continuous learning.

· Competitive compensation, annual performance bonuses, and access to DAZN streaming.

· Employee wellness benefits, mental health support (Unmind), and learning resources.

At DAZN, we bring ambition to life.

If you’re an architect who thrives on solving complex challenges and shaping the future of mobile streaming, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Senior Product Designer - Android
description:
**Equal AI**
is building India’s personal AI assistant.

Founded in
**2022**
, we recently raised a
**$30M Series B**
, co-led by Prosus Ventures and Tomales Bay Capital, taking our total funding beyond $42M. Today, more than 2 million monthly active users rely on Equal AI for everyday conversations.

Our voice-first assistant answers calls on a user’s behalf, understands who is calling and why, briefs the user on what happened, and helps them take the next action. We’re building a new consumer category at the intersection of AI, voice and consumer technology.

We’re looking for a Senior Product Designer to own the Android app end to end.

What you’ll own

* The
  **Android app**
  , end to end — one designer, one surface, the last call on what ships
* The design system: scaling it, not inheriting it
* The interfaces nobody has a template for yet — what the screen does while the AI is listening, what happens when it mishears, how a user reviews what the assistant said on their behalf
* Consent, permissions and privacy flows across the app
* Design review as a practice: how decisions get written down and who signs off
* Mentoring a junior designer (one seat today, growing with the team)

You’ll work closely with our Product, Engineering and Growth teams to take surfaces from problem to production and keep the bar high as the app scales.

What we’re looking for

* **5–7 years in product design**
  , with at least one consumer (B2C / D2C) app shipped to real users at scale
* Experience as the only or primary designer on a product — you’ve owned the standard, not just contributed to it
* **Hands-on Android design**
  across Indian device and OS spread, and a clear view of what that constrains
* Evidence of shipping into constraint: something that degraded between Figma and production, and what you did about it
* Experience building or materially extending a design system
* Strong instincts on consent and privacy design

We value people who move fast, take ownership and care deeply about outcomes. The playbook won’t always exist—you should be comfortable launching, learning, iterating and scaling.

If you’re excited about designing the interface for an entirely new consumer AI category, we’d love to hear from you.

description:

The Time and Pay Innovation team is chartered to build a world-class product that meets attendance and pay computation needs for millions of hourly associates across Amazon businesses. People Technology is the central hub for all Amazon people data. Our technology provides the foundation and orchestration for a multitude of key human resource processes — from onboarding tens of thousands of temporary employees during peak holiday season to integrating critical employee data with internal and external systems. * Design, develop, and operate large-scale distributed systems that process time, attendance, and pay data for millions of associates worldwide
* Own the end-to-end architecture and delivery of critical features, from ideation through production

* Mentor and develop junior engineers, fostering a culture of ownership and continuous improvement
* Collaborate cross-functionally with product managers, stakeholders, and partner teams to define technical roadmaps
* Identify and resolve ambiguous problems, making sound trade-off decisions in a fast-paced environment

* 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
* 5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
* 5+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience

title: Flutter Engineering Intern (Mobile)
description:
**Mobile apps built for serious work are held to a different standard than consumer apps. We’re hiring someone who wants to learn it.**

Nyayasiddhi, an Indian legaltech company, is hiring a
**Flutter Engineering Intern**
to join our mobile engineering team in India.

This role suits an engineer who cares about performance, reliability and the discipline of building for professionals who use their tools for hours at a stretch.

**The engineering you’ll do**

* Build responsive, production-grade mobile interfaces in Flutter and Dart
* Integrate REST APIs reliably, with graceful network-failure handling and offline resilience where it matters
* Implement state management that keeps the UI consistent with backend data and free of race conditions
* Profile and optimise load times, memory usage and battery drain, so the app stays out of the user’s way
* Join code reviews and work with backend and design teams, understanding how each mobile decision affects the wider platform
* Question the experience you’re building: does it hold up for someone working under pressure, with real stakes?

**What we expect from you**

* Working knowledge of Flutter and Dart fundamentals
* Understanding of REST APIs and JSON handling
* Comfort with widgets, layouts and navigation patterns
* Solid programming fundamentals: data structures, error handling, clean code
* Comfort with Git and pull-request workflows
* Honesty about what you don’t know, and eagerness to learn

You don’t need to know Flutter already. Learning quickly is what matters, along with caring about software people can depend on.

**A real advantage if you have it**

* State management patterns: Provider, Riverpod or BLoC
* Platform-specific debugging on iOS and Android
* Navigation and deep-linking patterns
* Flutter testing, Firebase integration and performance profiling
* Experience building for professionals or knowledge workers
* Shipped features used by people under real pressure

**The terms, stated plainly**

* Location: India (on-site / hybrid)
* Type: Internship, Paid
* After 3 months, high performers convert to paid roles, based on reliability on real devices, edge-case handling, code quality, proactive learning and collaboration

**What you gain**

Hands-on experience shipping mobile for a production platform, mentorship from engineers who take technical rigour seriously, and early exposure to legaltech.

**How to apply**

Email your resume, GitHub/GitLab profile (or a code sample) and a short note covering:

1. One mobile or Flutter project you’ve built
2. What went wrong while building it
3. What you’d change if you built it again, thinking about how someone would actually use it

Additional Screening Questions to be answered by email.

Describe one Flutter or mobile project you’ve built. What was your specific contribution?

1. What went wrong while building it, and how did you find and fix the problem?

2. If you rebuilt it today, what would you change, thinking about how someone would actually use it?

3. Your app loses network connection halfway through a user action. How would you design it to behave?

Subject:
*Application – Flutter Engineering Intern*

Email: reachus@nyayasiddhi.com

Know a Flutter developer who builds with care? Please share this with them.

  Write, maintain, and execute comprehensive test cases based on product requirements and user scenarios.

  Identify, document, and track defects with clear reproduction steps, logs, and supporting evidence.

  Test LLM-based systems for response accuracy, relevance, contextual understanding, consistency, and unexpected behavior.
* **Conversational Flow Validation:**
  Validate conversational flows, various user inputs, edge cases, and failure scenarios in AI-powered applications.
* **Android Debugging:**
  Utilize Android debugging tools such as ADB and Logcat to investigate issues.
* **Test Automation Support:**
  Write basic Python scripts to support internal test automation, test data preparation, and repetitive validation tasks.
* **Team Collaboration:**
  Collaborate closely with developers and product teams to validate fixes, report progress, and ensure high product quality.

**Requirements & Qualifications**

* **Experience:**
  1 to 4 years of experience in software testing, preferably with Android applications.
* **Software Testing Fundamentals:**
  Good understanding of core software testing fundamentals, test case design, functional testing, and regression testing.
* **AI / LLM Understanding:**
  Basic understanding of LLM-based applications and AI testing concepts.
* **Scripting Skills:**
  Basic Python scripting knowledge for testing and automation support.
* **Analytical & Communication Skills:**
  Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
* **Adaptability & Ownership:**
  Ability to take ownership of assigned tasks and deliver within timelines.

**Key Skills & Exposure**

* Android application testing and debugging tools (ADB, Logcat)
* AI / LLM response testing, conversational flow validation, and edge-case testing
* Basic Python scripting for test automation and data preparation
* Functional, regression, integration, and exploratory testing

**Nice to Have / Preferred**

* Experience testing voice assistants or conversational AI applications
* Exposure to ASR (Automated Speech Recognition), TTS (Text-to-Speech), or other voice-based technologies
* Basic knowledge of API testing using Postman
* Familiarity with Jira, TestRail, Git, or similar tools

title: Senior Product Manager - Mobile Apps
description:
Driven by the passion to improve quality of people’s lives, WSA continues to grow as market leader in the hearing aid industry. With our commitment to increase penetration in an underserved hearing care market, we want to accelerate our business transformation in order to reach more people, more effectively.
  
  
The Senior Product Manager is one of the key roles in shaping the company’s digital transformation as it evolves from a hardware-driven to a software-led organization.
  
  
The position holds global responsibility for development of WSA’s consumer hearing aid mobile application, which represents the primary interface between the company and hearing aid wearers.
  
  
This role ensures that the mobile app drives measurable consumer engagement, supports commercial growth, and strengthens brand positioning through digital innovation and data-driven decision-making.
  
  
The incumbent operates with a high degree of autonomy, guiding cross-functional team and influencing business direction across global markets.
  
  
In addition to commercial ownership, the role includes direct leadership of a small, international product team operating across India and Europe. The successful candidate will foster collaboration across diverse cultural and functional contexts, bridging engineering execution in India with strategic and commercial leadership in Europe. Serve as a cultural connector, promoting effective collaboration between Western and Indian business environments.
  
  
What you will do
  
  
**Product Leadership**

* Define and execute the long-term vision and strategy for the consumer application in the WSA ecosystem, aligned with corporate digital transformation goals.
* Translate market dynamics, user insights, and technological trends into a differentiated app strategy and product roadmap.
* Provide product leadership across functions, balancing innovation, commercial priorities, and feasibility.

**Commercial and Analytical Ownership**

* Drive the commercial evaluation of digital initiatives, including business case development, ROI assessment, and financial forecasting.
* Ensure that app initiatives are supported by robust performance metrics and consumer feedback loops.
* Leverage and steer consumer data and analytics to shape feature priorities, drive retention, and optimize lifetime user value.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Act as the primary interface between business, engineering, and market teams, translating strategic intent into deliverable software solutions.
* Collaborate closely with R&D and software engineering teams, particularly with Indian development partners, ensuring effective global collaboration and delivery alignment.
* Partner with marketing, UX, and commercial teams to ensure end-to-end product excellence and regulatory compliance.

**Global Scope and Influence**
Represent the voice of the global consumer across markets, ensuring the product experience resonates across cultures, languages, and regulatory environments.
  
  
What you bring
  
  
**Education & Professional Background**

* Master’s or Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, or related field.
* 8+ years of progressive experience in product management, ideally in digital health, consumer tech, or connected device industries.
* Strong understanding of software engineering processes, agile methodologies, and lifecycle management from a commercial standpoint.

**Technical & Functional Expertise**

* Proven experience managing data-driven consumer applications.
* Strong analytical mindset, with ability to synthesize market data, user analytics, and financial insights.
* Expertise in commercial planning and business case development for digital products.

**Leadership & Collaboration**

* Demonstrated ability to lead through influence in a matrixed global organization.
* Experience working with or leading teams in India or collaborating with Indian software partners.
* Multilingual proficiency and experience working across multiple cultures preferred.

**Behavioral Competencies**

* Strategic and conceptual thinker with strong execution drive.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
* High integrity, cultural awareness, and adaptability in a global context.
* Passion for improving the end-user experience through digital innovation, whether in app or through use of app data.

Who we are
  
  
At WSA, we provide innovative hearing aids and hearing health services.
  
  
Together with our 12,000 colleagues in 130 countries, we invite you to help unlock human potential by bringing back hearing for millions of people around the world.
  
  
With us, you will become part of a truly global company where we care for one another, welcome diversity and celebrate our successes.
  
  
Sounds wonderful? We can't wait to hear from you.

title: Sr. Associate Salesforce Engineer
description:
As a Salesforce Software Engineer within our global Commercialization Technology team, this role will help evolve portfolio governance operations capabilities. Come join a team that is passionate about innovation and making life better with technology!
  
  
This position will involve hands-on development on the Salesforce platform, including declarative configuration, custom Salesforce development, integrations, APIs, and secure enterprise delivery. The successful candidate will work closely with product owners, architects, and agile teams to deliver enterprise technology solutions primarily using Salesforce, while also contributing to custom web and integration technologies such as React, TypeScript, Python, and modern API frameworks when appropriate.
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities:**

* Develop, enhance, and support Salesforce applications using established engineering standards and architectural guidance.
* Design and implement Salesforce solutions using declarative capabilities such as objects, fields, page layouts, validation rules, Flows, approval processes, security settings, and user access.
* Evaluate business and technical requirements to determine appropriate implementation approaches, including Salesforce declarative capabilities, custom Salesforce development, integrations, and custom full-stack components when needed.
* Develop user experiences on the Salesforce Lightning Platform using Lightning Web Components and other supported Salesforce technologies.
* Enhance and maintain Salesforce products and solutions using Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flows, and platform configuration within capabilities such as Service Cloud and Experience Cloud.
* Translate user stories, wireframes, and design specifications into high-quality, reusable Salesforce components and user experiences.
* Develop and maintain integrations between Salesforce and enterprise APIs, databases, data services, and other business applications.

* Develop and contribute to appropriate unit, integration, API, UI, accessibility, security, and data-validation testing as part of the software development lifecycle.

* Use source control, code reviews, CI/CD, Salesforce deployment tooling, monitoring, rollback, and incident-management practices to support reliable application delivery.

title: India First Engineer
description:
Supply & Friends is a New York City based AI company building modern, beautiful software for the fashion industry, the world’s largest creative industry and its most global. Our mission is to grow global GDP and connect the world's cultures.

India is one of the most ambitious and future-facing countries in the world, and is central to our mission. We are excited to bring on our First India Engineer in Hyderabad, Bangalore, or Chennai to help us build the next generation of AI-native product (and infra).

We are intentionally discreet about what we are building. You will learn more when we chat.

**Our core values**

* Unflinching Optimism. Let's make this world even better.
* Global DNA: Think, act, be global from day one.
* Respect the domain. Study it and learn from others to master it.
* 1st generation immigrant mindset. Work hard, don't take anything for granted.
* Honest trade & commerce. Act with integrity.
* Bring beauty into the world. Let our products reflect the beauty of the industry we serve.
* Arm the makers. Free them up with great technology to do what they do best: CREATE.
* Customers, customers, customers. Always start with the customer first.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a Full-Stack + LLM Engineer in India who wants real ownership and intensity.

Not a narrow specialist.

Not a pure researcher.

Not a ticket-closer.

We want a hacker and builder. You will not be a small cog in a large machine. You will help define how this product evolves.

This is a fast-moving, high ownership role. You will be our 1st engineer in India and a foundational part of our long-term presence here.

We operate at very high intensity. 70+ hours and 6+ days per week is normal for us. This is not seasonal. This is how we build. If you are optimizing for balance first, this is not the right role for you.

**Role mission**

Design, build, and ship AI-native web experiences that combine world-class full-stack engineering with real-world LLM systems -- including reasoning models, decision models, and agentic pipelines -- helping us take an AI-native product used by global customers from early traction to real scale.

You will:

* Build beautiful, fast, production-grade frontend systems in React
* Architect and own backend systems: APIs, data models, and services
* Integrate and orchestrate LLM workflows -- including reasoning models, decision models, and multi-step agentic pipelines -- into product flows
* Own features end-to-end, from idea to shipped code
* Define how AI features are surfaced and integrated into core product workflows
* Continuously improve the quality, reliability, and UX of AI-powered features in production

**Role outcomes**

* Within the first two weeks:
* Understand customers, product, UX philosophy, tech stack & AI architecture
* Familiarize yourself with the codebase, internal tools, and services
* Ship meaningful code, including at least 1 feature
* Within 45 days:
* Own full features across frontend, backend, and LLM logic
* Improve UX polish and system responsiveness
* Propose improvements to AI workflows
* Within 90 days:
* Architect and ship major AI-powered product flows
* Take responsibility for performance, reliability, and LLM evaluation workflows
* Improve our team workflows to be more efficient and productive
* Within 6-12 months:
* Help build the India engineering core
* Raise the bar on full-stack craft and AI-native thinking
* Lead major product surfaces across web and mobile
* Travel occasionally to meet customers globally
* Always:
* Talk directly to users around the world
* Ship fast
* Iterate
* Maintain high standards for reliability and stability

**Our tech stack**

* AI: GPT, Gemini, Claude, GLM (Zhipu), Jev (TypeSafe), Cursor, evaluation pipelines
* Frontend: React, Vite, Tailwind
* Backend: NodeJS, Express, Postgres, AWS, Modal, DeepInfra, Cloudfront
* ML / open source: SigLIP, OWL-ViT v2, DINOv2, pHash, dHash
* Analytics: Posthog, Sentry

**You:**

* Have 3 to 7 years of experience building real products end-to-end, across frontend and backend
* Are extremely strong in React and modern frontend frameworks
* Have solid backend experience: API design, data modeling, and building reliable services
* Have built and shipped things outside of your job simply because you were curious, and can show us what you made
* Think like a product owner, not just an implementer, and care about the customer and business
* Care deeply about UX, speed, and polish
* Have built real LLM-powered features in production -- not just demos -- using reasoning models, decision models, agentic pipelines, structured outputs, and evaluation frameworks
* Understand prompt engineering, context management, and failure handling at scale
* Have worked with or have a point of view on decision models like Jev and how they differ from traditional generative LLMs
* Want your code to have impact and you're a self-motivated super hard worker
* Are excited to work fully remotely (and occasionally in person)
* Live in Hyderabad, Bangalore, or Chennai and are excited to be based there long-term

*Bonus points if you:*

* Have worked at a high-grade startup or product company (Swiggy, Zepto, Razorpay, Meesho, CRED, Groww, or similar)
* Have prior experience in B2B SaaS, fashion tech, or e-commerce
* Have an eye for design and/or a sense of craftsmanship
* Are a curious world citizen with empathy for other cultures and/or speak 2+ languages
* Have built personal AI tools, bots, SaaS, or internal productivity systems
* Have contributed to open source

**What's in this for you**

* High ownership from day one
* Direct exposure to global customers
* Travel opportunities
* Salary competitive for the India market, with equity upside (stock options).
* The opportunity to become a foundational engineering leader in India

**How to apply**

We are intentionally selective and use a rigorous process.

If this excites you, please get started by applying on LinkedIn. We review every application.

* Own features from technical design and development through release and post\-production monitoring

* Strong understanding of Swift Concurrency, async/await, actors, Combine, and asynchronous programming

 SDE III

* Experience with modular iOS architecture and multi\-module codebases

* Understanding of iOS security, Keychain, encryption, certificate pinning, data protection, and application hardening
* Experience publishing or actively maintaining applications on the Apple App Store
* Experience working in fast\-paced product or start\-up environments


**What We Look For**
* Strong ownership and a product\-first approach
* Ability to balance development speed with long\-term engineering quality
* Attention to interaction details, usability, and application performance
* Clear communication and effective cross\-functional collaboration
* Ability to work through ambiguity and convert broad product requirements into scalable technical solutions
